subject: Judge Demands Answers on FBI ‘Burn Bag’ Records
body:
Judicial Watch Requests Fed Subpoenas

[INSIDE JW]

FEDERAL JUDGE DEMANDS ANSWERS ON FBI ‘BURN BAG ROOM’ RECORDS

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84924&L=38540&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1qbUJGZEh5dzJMUSZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=66b52b8424c9dbac7f614e1ea8e9d2da8dc78b731ff682536a68ada9f030d068]

The FBI’s “burn bag room” case just got a lot more interesting.
A federal judge is now demanding answers.

A federal judge has ordered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=84924&L=38536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1hdWctb3JkZXItMDQwNDcvXXRoZT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=3667b1c683f5567afdc64e867eef892d1b9f657df4f8cf2cd1cd71296c19a914
U.S. Department of Justice to provide answers about nearly 2 million
pages of FBI records, including whether the records have already been
reviewed in response to other Freedom of Information Act (FOIA)
requests and whether the newly uncovered records had been stored in

clean_body: Judicial Watch Requests Fed Subpoenas [INSIDE JW] FEDERAL JUDGE DEMANDS ANSWERS ON FBI ‘BURN BAG ROOM’ RECORDS [] The FBI’s “burn bag room” case just got a lot more interesting. A federal judge is now demanding answers. A federal judge has ordered [ U.S. Department of Justice to provide answers about nearly 2 million pages of FBI records, including whether the records have already been reviewed in response to other Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests and whether the newly uncovered records had been stored in other government record systems: Upon consideration of the parties’ Joint Status Report [] [ as discussed at [the August 3, 2026] status conference, it is ORDERED that the parties shall file a joint status report on or before September 4, 2026. In addition to updating the Court on the parties’ progress in narrowing the issues, the joint status report shall include the government’s responses to the following: (1) Whether the legacy and/or recent records at issue in this FOIA request have previously been considered or reviewed in response to other FOIA requests; and (2) Whether the legacy and/or recent records at issue in this FOIA request are contained in any other systems of records or indices. The government shall also determine whether it can provide additional information regarding the nature of the two investigations it represents are reflected in the legacy files. The order comes in our November 2025 FOIA lawsuit [] filed after the FBI failed to respond to a June 2025 request for all records stored in the room. Former FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino disclosed in May 2025 that FBI officials had discovered a large volume of records in the room that had not been properly processed or digitized. The FBI subsequently told the court that the room contains 20 five-drawer filing cabinets holding an estimated 950,000 to 1.9 million pages of records (Judicial Watch v U.S. Department of Justice [)). In July 2026, the Justice Department told the court that, at a rate of 500 pages a month, processing records from the “hidden room” at FBI Headquarters would take approximately 158 years []. The room — now dubbed the “burn bag room” — holds over 2 million pages of records, according to the FBI’s own filing. There is one safe, believed to contain “legacy files,” that is yet to be accessed []. Bongino said in May 2025 that some of the records were found stashed “in bags:” There was a room [in FBI Headquarters], and we found stuff. A lot of stuff ... hidden from us at least and not mentioned to us. And then found stuff in there. A lot is from the Comey era. We are working ... right now to declassify. And just so you know, because I get the public—I totally understand people saying “well do it now.” The process is: not all of the information is ours to declassify. Some is other intelligence agencies’.... We literally can’t do it. Once that gets done ... and you read some of the stuff we found—that, by the way, was not processed through the normal procedure, digitizing and putting in FBI records. We found it in bags, hiding under Jim Comey’s FBI. You’re going to be stunned. We previously uncovered [] that the room is a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) containing several safes—now identified as 20 file cabinets—holding between roughly 950,000 and 1,900,000 pages of records, split into two categories: “legacy files,” older records mostly tied to two closed historical investigations and more recent files tied to active investigations and prior Special Counsel records, reportedly including material connected to Special Counsel Jack Smith. More than a year after we submitted our FOIA request, the FBI has yet to begin processing the records sought. The parties must report to Judge Friedrich by September 4, 2026, on their progress and provide the specific information demanded by the court. American citizens should be outraged that the FBI has told a federal judge it could take 158 years to process the records in its secret ‘burn bag’ room. Now the court is demanding answers about whether these records were previously searched, whether they are stored in records systems as federal law requires, and what two mysterious investigations are represented in the “legacy” files. It is urgent that the American people receive all the details on how the FBI was used as a political weapon against Donald Trump and other Americans. The Justice Department and FBI should stop the stonewalling and get these records out. This is the latest in a series of Judicial Watch investigations targeting shady FBI weaponization and abuse of power. In August 2025, we sued [] the Justice Department for all records regarding the FBI, under then-Director James Comey, initiating an investigation of then-2016 presidential candidate Donald Trump. In May 2020, we uncovered the FBI “EC”—the electronic communication [] that officially launched the counterintelligence investigation, termed “Crossfire Hurricane,” of Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign. The document was written by former FBI official Peter Strzok and was obtained as the result of a Judicial Watch FOIA lawsuit [] for: “The Electronic Communication that initiated the counterintelligence investigation of Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign.” In August 2019, we uncovered “302” report material [] from FBI interviews with Bruce Ohr, who was removed from his position as U.S. Associate Deputy Attorney General in December 2017. In March 2019, we received [] heavily redacted records from the Justice Department that reveal that Ohr remained in regular contact with former British spy and Fusion GPS contractor Christopher Steele after Steele was terminated [] by the FBI in November 2016 for revealing to the media his position as an FBI confidential informant. In December 2018, we uncovered [] U.S. State Department documents showing classified information was researched and disseminated to multiple U.S. Senators by the Obama administration immediately prior to Trump’s inauguration. The documents reveal that among those receiving the classified documents were Sen. Mark Warner (D-VA), Sen. Ben Cardin (D-MD), and Sen. Robert Corker (R-TN). Judicial Watch obtained the documents through a FOIA lawsuit for records of the Obama State Department’s last-minute efforts to share classified information about Russia election interference issues with Cardin. In August 2018, we announced that in response to a our FOIA lawsuit [], the Justice Department admitted in a court filing [] that the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court held no hearings on the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) spy warrant applications targeting Carter Page, a former Trump campaign part-time advisor who was the subject of four controversial FISA warrants. Also in August, we forced the release [] of heavily redacted records [] about Christopher Steele, the former British spy, hired with Clinton campaign and Democratic National Committee funds, who authored the infamous dossier targeting Trump during last year’s presidential campaign. The documents show that Steele was cut off as a “Confidential Human Source” (CHS) after he disclosed his relationship with the FBI to a third party. The documents also show at least 11 FBI payments to Steele in 2016 and document that he was admonished for unknown reasons in February 2016. In July 2018, we released documents [] about FISA warrants targeting Carter Page, who had been a Trump campaign adviser. JUDICIAL WATCH SEEKS RELEASE OF FEDERAL RESERVE GRAND JURY SUBPOENAS The Federal Reserve wants to keep grand jury subpoenas about a criminal investigation involving Chairman Jerome Powell and the $2.5 billion renovation of the Fed’s headquarters under wraps. We are asking a federal court to make the Fed turn them over. We asked the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia to order [] the Federal Reserve to release two grand jury subpoenas issued in connection with a criminal investigation involving Chairman Powell and his $2.5 billion renovation of the Federal Reserve’s headquarters. We filed an April 2026 Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit [] after the Federal Reserve failed to comply with our January 2026 FOIA request seeking access to the subpoenas issued by the U.S. Department of Justice (Judicial Watch, Inc. v. Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System [] (No. 1:26-cv-01113)). The Federal Reserve is asking the court to grant it summary judgment and uphold its withholding of the subpoenas under FOIA Exemption 5 [], which covers privileged interagency or intra-agency memoranda or letters. In a memorandum filed August 17, we opposed the Board’s motion and filed a cross-motion for summary judgment, arguing that Exemption 5 does not apply because the records are not internal Federal Reserve deliberations but grand jury subpoenas that the Board received and possesses. We are asking the court to reject the Board’s position and order the release of the records. We argue: Grand jury subpoenas are compulsory process, not inter-agency or intra-agency communications. The Board’s own conduct defeats its position. The Board did not request these subpoenas, did not consult with the prosecutors who served them, and received them in no advisory capacity whatsoever. It retained outside counsel and moved to quash them. The Board’s own words remove any doubt. Vought sent a letter [ Powell on July 10, 2025, questioning the project’s management and compliance with federal standards. Vought publicly compared [] aspects of the renovation to elements that belong in France’s “Palace of Versailles.” The Federal Reserve is hiding grand jury subpoenas about potential crimes and public corruption from the American people. These are not internal deliberations—they are legal process served on the Fed. The Board should stop stonewalling and release the records. The agency uses the gender neutral pronoun “they” when referring to the doctoral student, who appears to be a biological woman in the biography [] published by the University of Maryland, College Park School of Public Health. Ezra specializes in researching gender minorities in families with a specific focus on the experiences of “Seahorse dads,” a term created by the left to describe biological women who identify as men and are therefore known as “transmasculine individuals who give birth.” The graduate student who just received thousands of taxpayer dollars plans to explore how transgender parents, specifically “seahorse dads,” navigate parenting roles after birth, according to the college biography. This includes in what contexts does gender dysphoria show up in transmasculine parenthood and what socialization messages are transgender parents sending to their children about gender. Last fall Ezra and a fellow researcher published an academic paper [] on so-called “seahorse dads” that concludes they resist being labeled as mothers. The paper claims to account for the experiences of transgender and gender nonconforming (TGNC) people who become parents. “Drawing from queer, gender, and life course perspectives, we introduce theoretical expansions that center the reciprocal, time-sensitive relationship between gender expression and parenthood,” the published academic paper states, adding that it explores how seahorse dads disrupt "normative assumptions,” and reshape family relationships. _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=2895%2E259176%2EfuPcYh) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=2895%2E259176%2EfuPcYh)_

Our campaign is entering a new chapter.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125617?t=6&akid=27948%2E878179%2EAP2F7m) Friend, it’s Justin J. Pearson.

When Tennessee Republicans passed new, unfair, racist maps designed to **_eliminate TN-09_ as the state’s _only majority-Black,_ Democratic district **— they thought that would be the end of our Movement.

**They couldn’t have been more wrong.**

We’re still here. We’re still mobilizing our People and communities. And we’re still building something the far-right can’t buy and can’t take away from us.

**That’s truly powerful, friend.** But now our campaign is entering a new chapter — one that’s going to test us in different ways than anything we’ve faced so far. As we continue forging ahead, I’m hoping I can count on your support.

[So please, split a donation of $9 or more between our Movement and the Voter Protection Project to Defend District 9 and its communities from the GOP’s authoritarian power grab.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125617?t=7&akid=27948%2E878179%2EAP2F7m) | [CHIP IN $9 TO DEFEND DISTRICT 9! »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125617?t=8&akid=27948%2E878179%2EAP2F7m)
---
After the Supreme Court gave the green light, Donald Trump and his extremist allies have been eager to push racist redistricting schemes — across the South, state by state, district by district, so they can choose their voters instead of letting voters choose their leaders.

And Republicans have eagerly backed this effort. _Why?_ It’s simple: **when more People can freely _and_ fairly participate in our democracy, Republicans risk losing their grip on power. **

That’s why they’re redistricting now — _well before_ voters get to have a say in November.

I won’t sugarcoat it — we have our work cut out for us. The new TN-09 is _vast._ Which means we have more miles to travel, more voters to reach, more noise to cut through, and more pressure from people who want us to run out of steam.

But I’ve seen what this Movement is capable of. With your support, we will emerge victorious and deliver the better tomorrow that our neighbors and communities have been waiting for.

[Friend, split a donation of $9 or more in the next 9 minutes between the Voter Protection Project and our grassroots campaign to defend our district from those who have come to do us harm. ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125617?t=9&akid=27948%2E878179%2EAP2F7m)

body:
Democrats won in a MASSIVE upset this week

| | | [ ](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=uGD1_JWQzocUoO6G1sZMF-tYIAuKQ97Z_lDiPedGAn11JJNENg30eeUPXVkqayxCfDLIkkjdPcC_U3XuHRoCIwMELeQenzQ2oHmoOYJU340&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_vi&n=1)
---
Democrats won in a MASSIVE upset this week, beating a Republican in a Pennsylvania district that Trump won by 18 points! **Seats that were considered “deep red” in 2024 are officially in play.** **And TX-27 is one of them.** I was not surprised to hear these results, because when I’ve looked out at the crowds at our recent events, I've noticed something incredible: at almost every stop, I’m seeing fewer and fewer familiar faces. Republicans are showing up and speaking out! Republicans who are just as fed up with Trump as I am. They trusted him to lower prices. _Instead, gas, groceries, and rent are all up._ They trusted him to look out for rural communities. _Instead, his Big “Beautiful” Bill is closing hospitals in the areas they are needed most._ The momentum is on our side, and **we have a truly historic opportunity to flip TX-27 blue and elect a representative who isn’t afraid to stand up to Trump.** **_This Upcoming Events at a Glance_** _Tomorrow and Sunday, August 22nd and 23rd_ | Join Texas Together in their efforts to [virtually phone bank](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=QaBiD9DC1F2AsvAB6C3L__bjX-pekk-I9zzATZytdeg63sPOnSaa3YHfScAs_848Vf69IJsAPdSgVxttpV77Tg&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_vi&n=2) and connect with voters all across our state. _Monday, August 24th_ | If you’re looking to get out in your community, join Texas Together as they support [canvassing efforts](https://www.tanyafortexas.com/r?u=QaBiD9DC1F2AsvAB6C3L__bjX-pekk-I9zzATZytdeg63sPOnSaa3YHfScAs_848bJeB_wGsJXJHjWL5EumIxw&e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_vi&n=3) in neighborhoods like yours and mine. _Saturday, August 29th_ | Sign up for upcoming events like our [Brenham Meet & Greet](https://www.tanyafortx27.com/meet_greet_in_brenham?e=e318ce027ee4de3e55dda42c4424aaf7&utm_source=tanyafortexas&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_vi&n=4). If you have friends or family in the area, please share this email with them as well!****
---

body:
The DOJ isn't sending a historic number of election monitors because voter fraud exists, it's because it doesn't. What they're hoping to catch isn't fraud, but any slip-up or honest mistake by a poll
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001w8-HKbmo1LXi_i7HmHkUtlOFi6kEk-6bKBiF6Ku8hMSpuzX8RSTWhsK6J54CtBq3NLIE7zT-lZ-XXW-PO6otJvZafnpfSuD6ZB_tYqCCQ4gsC-olbV_J9O_PKzYrzcdjCYFsHKPiNhTkp5bwSqbbmuIt1j-5xcNMckw-FeK8nHAeEAaXRN5TcWtr9A05_d_j1dZaDWXfjO0QjIDMzhosSujzNgDMgJnSK0tkeiuvf1Bm0Hqh8nKXeg==&c=eqkhGilLKbusxjUA30IT9rFzniUd_VXKA_6t-ai7IwvPsbUECRMUFQ==&ch=LEYodXvmEgcHy6pDt0JQBLU-uxrxAfh0mbQlT32iDBOcjVoladLo5Q==)

|
Peter,
The Department of Justice has been busy under its new leader, Todd Blanche, Trump's former personal lawyer. But they haven't been fighting crime. On the contrary, the DOJ seems to be gearing up to commit crimes of its own.
Last month, Donald Trump gave a national address on elections where he floated completely made up data and reheated debunked conspiracies to lay the groundwork to use unconstitutional and highly illegal actions to challenge the results of the upcoming midterms.
Now, Todd Blanche is putting Trump's plan into motion. It was just announced the DOJ will be sending a record breaking one thousand election monitors to polling locations for the midterm elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001w8-HKbmo1LXi_i7HmHkUtlOFi6kEk-6bKBiF6Ku8hMSpuzX8RSTWhsK6J54CtBq3NLIE7zT-lZ-XXW-PO6otJvZafnpfSuD6ZB_tYqCCQ4gsC-olbV_J9O_PKzYrzcdjCYFsHKPiNhTkp5bwSqbbmuIt1j-5xcNMckw-FeK8nHAeEAaXRN5TcWtr9A05_d_j1dZaDWXfjO0QjIDMzhosSujzNgDMgJnSeyyWLuOuRF-bnw55p_loQQ==&c=eqkhGilLKbusxjUA30IT9rFzniUd_VXKA_6t-ai7IwvPsbUECRMUFQ==&ch=LEYodXvmEgcHy6pDt0JQBLU-uxrxAfh0mbQlT32iDBOcjVoladLo5Q==)
---
There is no doubt what the Trump admin is intending with this move. The DOJ isn't sending a historic number of election monitors because voter fraud exists, it's because it doesn't. What they're hoping to catch isn't fraud, but any slip-up or honest mistake by a poll worker--any excuse, however small, to challenge an election's results.
And don't take it just from us. One state election official laid out to NPR earlier this month what this could look like in practice: a DOJ monitor finds a pretext to challenge a result, a friendly judge issues subpoenas the day after Election Day, agents show up at a county office in a close race, and walk out with the ballots "so we can count them."
This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. We're building a firewall of state Supreme Courts, the courts with ultimate say over election law in their states, and the last line of defense when Trump tries to steal an election in broad daylight.
There are only 77 days left until the midterm elections. We have to be prepared for the worst, and make this election too big to rig. But for us to fight at the scale this moment demands, we have to dramatically build our war chest, right now. And that means we need the help of Democrats everywhere today.
[Free and fair elections are under attack. But they haven't been fighting crime. On the contrary, the DOJ seems to be gearing up to commit crimes of its own. Last month, Donald Trump gave a national address on elections where he floated completely made up data and reheated debunked conspiracies to lay the groundwork to use unconstitutional and highly illegal actions to challenge the results of the upcoming midterms. Now, Todd Blanche is putting Trump's plan into motion. It was just announced the DOJ will be sending a record breaking one thousand election monitors to polling locations for the midterm elections. | == There is no doubt what the Trump admin is intending with this move. The DOJ isn't sending a historic number of election monitors because voter fraud exists, it's because it doesn't. What they're hoping to catch isn't fraud, but any slip-up or honest mistake by a poll worker--any excuse, however small, to challenge an election's results. And don't take it just from us. One state election official laid out to NPR earlier this month what this could look like in practice: a DOJ monitor finds a pretext to challenge a result, a friendly judge issues subpoenas the day after Election Day, agents show up at a county office in a close race, and walk out with the ballots "so we can count them." This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. We're building a firewall of state Supreme Courts, the courts with ultimate say over election law in their states, and the last line of defense when Trump tries to steal an election in broad daylight. ## Trump Drops Tariffs on Beef Imports
President Trump announced Friday that the U.S. will allow [up to 300,000 metric tons of ground beef](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdKBlzRkoXKShu7QpkTG7hyODkdk7lL-PuHxCupFGeqM3X_fx7kIM2-PTrWSF07jReUQSoTxKfq77nNN-TEQsLgfmY5ucjAhoSuhKxNF5CS8aG1fMlomQdEG2brtW9xqhLxYLnQHf1W4i1uBqrXtzc6i59wxesy-CvXjQIdYApmkrc2tuqBG0N4yGnWqA5iApV98pbLIQx5_0olz5tBbRLiL7ofSHwkHhcJ5n5bfJX6XC4UIrHKC7cq1weFuVj5ye21xeYmVY95Sl_BOsFlljke28nyHGcJhWNfBYXYjvNfnnSS-LvwEAAP__3Mp7JA) to be imported without tariffs for 90 days, his latest move to bring down prices that have surged 57% in five years. Ground beef now [averages $6.89](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOhCAQBuCnwQ6DI8JuQXGN3V57pQEcVi4oBmY19_YXN_cG100yyf_n-78e08PGFLfnp13RUMjThmdNSIRlovJa97nkvTrEQLbEEOrmLE0gQHFx4wCT9RQPnKRtZhMQAfsGTadvur_3IO7NYlQIHc5SexE64TxIP6B3g9NuuFuhsYnmyhM3gE4IJXWrBjlAD6L3KoAKlkmBc6Rc2u8cN1owpJ98YGl9XptkFqK9sv6DwchgPM-z9a5ejuvPYLxOBuObw08bD6z8WfJrm_kF43HdcyH-B2QwNsXM-xlTilVpJsVztTG9y-ifGx0GfgMAAP__eXR97w) a pound, driven by the smallest U.S. cattle herd since the 1950s. Drought and high feed costs have forced ranchers to cut back, squeezing domestic supply. Trump [wrote on _Truth Social_ ](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuhDAQQNHTmG7RMDYGChdp6DZtSmRgZnFkMLJnF-X2UfYKucDT1_-6T3cfYjgen34nJ5ymg64SSYTyJPm5n2tOZ5mJWHwOzOWYvUwIaG_Q3xAnv0h40WR8tTomQtIVuabrOz1ohKHanIaZ5lbjQNDMzOwtN0trjR_6Fcyqq-D-POgRGwBrutq2pkWNoBfLaNkrA7QGSbn-TuGQjTj-pBflekl7Fd0mchalPxSOCsfruup3eZH8lK1O-aFwLOLlWagoHE0DBqvs1vMKMYZiO2XgsfsQ3578c8PL4W8AAAD__zZJclA)that the U.S. had a commitment that the beef would sell for 25% below current market prices, though he didn't say which countries would supply it. It's the government's second tariff waiver for beef this year, after allowing 80,000 metric tons of Argentine imports in February. The National Cattlemen's Beef Association criticized the move, saying it would not address Trump's stated intention of helping to increase the size of the U.S. beef herd.
## Roberts Lets Ballroom Build Continue, For Now
Chief Justice John Roberts [temporarily allowed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtSAUhJ8GOwwcvKgFxd_Y3b_d0iAertygGDhes2-_YV9huy-ZzExmvp7z04YYjtd_u6Mhn-YD7xKRCPNM-drPNaezLIiebA7el2OxNIMAzcXAAWbrKHxw7myzGo8IqBo0sh96NSoQY7OZYZRSSoFCW-mgopLCj6N7eOtB900wNU8MAFII3fWtfnQPUCCU0x60t6wTuAZKuX2ncNCGPn6nD-bWpb2JZiM6C1P_GEwMpvu-W7eUuqPqDKaKDKZynRl35C5dmfi9BUK-pasgX2yMOaWdv9N28JwWzFQdTTbreYcYQ9E968RrtyH-ltIfv_oY-AkAAP__-Qp_lg) construction of the White House ballroom to continue, issuing a last-minute stay on Friday just hours before a lower court order would have halted above-ground work at midnight. The order buys the full Supreme Court time to consider President Trump's [emergency appeal](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ8Gd0SbhWBcUPyNu_ztlRa2l8AJGwvWie7tT8krXD2aGX3f1326-5TT_vjvN3IcyrTTq2VipjpxPbdjreVoM1FgX1MIbZ89TwhoJFiJOPmF05Mm7bvVBSIk1ZG79rZXg0IYuugGC9raJVgarjcCaxet1GD6VQffQwhdcu89sIhXAKP7i7npGyoEtZiAJnihgdbEpV6-S9o5Usg_5Un1spStyy4yH02ofwJHgSNHiinndyZwrPQ4s-dUdoHjUs7KcvbMmZrA0YBW2oL8gMpXTEwylrORnH3OtZRNtvOotJH8VAWOXXXr8Uo5p2Z6oeGx-fT56viP-p4OfwMAAP__ry-F5g) of a D.C. Circuit ruling that found he lacked authority to build the $400 million, 90,000-square-foot project without congressional approval. The National Trust for Historic Preservation, which brought the lawsuit challenging the demolition of the original East Wing, had urged the justices not to intervene. Roberts' order contained no explanation and doesn't signal how the court will ultimately rule on the project's legality.
## Fed Report: Homeowners with No Mortgage
Nearly three-quarters of retiree homeowners [own their homes outright](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOqzAQheGnMZ2RGYMNhYvb0OW2W6IBxsErYyN7kihvv8q-wvZHR5_-r9tywxBDuv_Hkxz7vCR61UjMVBYuj_PaS77qSuQZS_C-phV5AQVGqlECLLhxeNLSY7M7TwSkG3KdHa2eNKipOdw2mUGj3vVKuClrLOxDN2q9auv9utomuM-fGgE6pUxvWzP0A2hQejMejEfRK9oD59J-55D4IB_f-Uml3fLZRHcwX1XofwJmAbMPCdNG7RuPnD8LAXMhjJIqI5OAGQuHLVIVMJ-Y3rIQh0JUZX4leeSTZH5wCfeDpfrAumHq2oPP2BS3X68QY6jGil7dTwzxF8F_bPd08BMAAP__fceEtg) with no remaining mortgage, according to the latest Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances. That share rises to 83% by ages 75 to 79, and 92% among those 85 and older, in stark contrast to younger generations. [Census Bureau data](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0E-OrCAQgPHT4E5TFv5jweJt2PXbztLQWigTEAPVmr79pOcKc4Hvl3xfj_lhffDH9t9G0uzSfNBdAjFTnjm_4rnmdJYnkWObvXPleFqeEXCoYaoRZ7uwv2jubLVqR4QkK9LtOI1SSQRV7XpUdqR2UjCuPYJqp0FBr5ydJC6wyqXy-tODCbEFGLqxGfquR4kgl8Hh4KzogFbPKTffyR-8kwvvdFFulhSroHfmswj5T6ARaO77bhY6yqs0W7oEmuCf2ea3QFM4ZU9FoPmAAg20Ak1MmTe7Ue0yUb2nSKXZOYYq6_W8fQi-DKPoYIvWh1-S_3jq0vgTAAD__wv0fNQ) show just 39.4% of all U.S. owner-occupied homes were mortgage-free in 2024, up from 34.4% a decade earlier. Only [45% of adults](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAQRb8GOqNhTAwpXLwmXV67JXLwOJ4VYGRPsPL3q-wvbH2vjo7O132-O155f_53G1kJad6plpVEKM-SX9vhczrKgyiIyxxC2R9OZgQ0CiaFOLtF-KR5cK23gQhJt2T7cRr1VSNc22iNCWCg70FrHGm5GuMnuFAY_LQswWHL9sODCbEHMMPYmctwQY2gFxPQBNcMQJ4l5e478S6RwvpOJ-VuSVu72ihylEb_a_DW4K3W2vF-UpF0kGf3OTV4i6mqze1vlUk4ExWV6q4kEmcV00YqvSTzM4qKlEkVVaOTz668E6dKTLWoHsEgwtBm64_K68rFjM0Az83x-msjf4x4WvwJAAD__3D4iHw) ages 25 to 34 own a home at all, compared with 81% of those 65 to 74, where ownership peaks. Higher interest rates and rising home prices have kept more owners in place long enough to pay down their loans. Owning outright can cut retirees' monthly costs significantly, though financial advisors say it isn't always the right call if it means depleting other savings.

Biological men should NOT be competing in girls' sports.

Washington needs to protect fairness in girls' sports, not let the WNBA push a woke agenda that erases it.

subject: Texas Leads in Jobs, Baylor Goes Retro, and San Antonio Goes Bananas
body:
Texas added 165,600 jobs over the past 12 months, more than any other state, according to [labor data released on Friday](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGutCAQBeCnwQ6Ds4hYUPyN3f7tLc0go7KLsBGy7r79jb7C7SY5yZcz5-c-3tEHH5f_uJEpnzmNkY4cqBTax0IfzIHQZR8fyWaL35D2JdEIAhQXmgOMOBX_plFi5YwVrm8qMk2nu1uvZCur1WiUE0irZtJtqwTo2badhblTnW4tisqbkxMaoGmEaKGWvSOyU6-1RT1hz6Qg50va67LSVWoO3_SmvZ7SVgWzlvLK7PaPwcBgOI6jfk7WnSGD4bQZDEKfd8NguAB-vcUjFp8ifyTLlz0dZeXonI8LP3XeqPZ5Zpk3wLcUy5oZDNVu3OvwIfisOibFsqEPV5Py1wXfBn4DAAD__-eihUI). Payrolls grew 1.2% from July 2025 to July 2026, a full percentage point above the national pace.

subject: I'm stepping down to give this my all.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE LINDELL FOR GOVERNOR**
body:
---
| | | | | |
---

_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| Mike Lindell for Governor I'm stepping down to give this my all. | | | | | [ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCH-MSdXJVm6nz1YZxLO_iG2-ahz4lJAbDDR6e9e6rRlXgs_WDBTPL1UNsF46qZNBwUHAp3lbpJ2YIEdZkd4Xzg2brQpEqbGUeB11Q)
---
Fellow American Patriot, Mike Lindell here, founder of MyPillow and [_**candidate for Minnesota Governor.**_](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCH_z5eKpbzzoOEjpqOdImyFB0E9Vw_7tJMOMWw6vNI4ak7GxE84OnLJ0zVZzMZe75WfjfYd6JAd7M0OcTW1cUOxXaqU3p1gCKXm7g) I'm reaching out because this week, I made one of the biggest decisions of my life. After 22 years leading the company I founded, I've stepped down as CEO of MyPillow. I didn't make that decision lightly. For more than two decades, MyPillow has been my life's work. Together, we built a Minnesota company from the ground up, created jobs, and proved that with faith, perseverance, and hard work, incredible things are still possible in this wonderful country.So why would I step away now?[**It's simple: because Minnesota deserves a Governor who is 100% committed.** ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCIABZK6acnILG9KnILqkkCyb9MwdGF18QztB2tvyx6luAv_s0LncBu81LT-LRXpi4AKy9Brcpi4yLGajZF9fZZiuJKjQF-13T2lRA)Minnesota deserves my complete focus, my full energy, and my undivided attention.I'm all in. 100% -- And today I'm hoping you're all in too.[**Will you click here to make a generous contribution to my campaign to take back our state and make Minnesota Great Again?**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCIBoLs2yGxZRD5GIzwCQTKy6vXhlZPHMRHzJIBj5a6zwrNLLo9T-0NCO1YJ8BPZ8L02FKl0NHKYaiJhWQsz_3_4imKBYWXJH2JMiA) My friend, this decision wasn't about walking away. It's about stepping up for you. Career politicians spend their lives protecting what's best for themselves. They worry about their next title, their next election, and their next opportunity.I'm choosing a different path. I'm putting Minnesota ahead of myself. I'm choosing the fight to save Minnesota and I'm giving it my all. I don't have a backup plan. I'm all in. President Trump honored me with his endorsement because he knows I'll fight for Minnesota without compromise. Now I'm backing up those words and his confidence with action by giving 100% to this campaign. But I can't do it by myself. **[I need grassroots conservatives across Minnesota-and across the country-standing with me.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCICFiGdffzIeaTXQlW2u9QlxPuWY7G4rBvDG_j2KD7FV_OSuhcSFmgYUxBX0lY9orbyAzdBxi1Aw_DuWjUsxtl6GxOycLQ54o25UQ)** _**_Every phone call we make..._**_ _**_Every yard sign we print..._**_ _**_Every door we knock..._**_ _**_Every voter we reach..._**_ It's only possible because people like you decide this campaign is worth fighting for. **If you believe Minnesota deserves a Governor who's willing to sacrifice, willing to lead, and willing to put our state first, I'm asking you to stand with me today.** **[Will you make a contribution of $10, $25, $50, or whatever you can afford to help me win this race?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCID9Whhv8ZOztCq20UjY6ZZryBuc25jOobM8u3sUbEMc_mFh4PikcSrCf1QBxQazctqIXDEq1Ca-bhaJjMc7ANbelY-W7AS4v8flg)** **_Together, we can save Minnesota._** **_I'm all in. I hope you'll be all in with me._**
---
| | | Thank you, and God bless.
---
**Mike Lindell,** _**Republican Candidate for Governor**_
---
| | [ ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCIE5uP4IIpCDKYiOcKJakj7CXeuc7sBUQts0TZzbD0yXy9tMdK2QhmnN1i57ZobCYSnovBhTxGi_YJly7E5_QYbwSR7I4YRKxQ7wA)
---
| | P.S. President Trump gave me his TOTAL ENDORSEMENT because he knows I will fight without compromise for Minnesota. If you want a career politician who sits by while fraud and crime run rampant, then maybe Lisa DeMuth or Amy Klobuchar are your candidate... **[But if you want a patriot and a businessman who will clean up the fraud and crime and make life better, safer, and more prosperous for Minnesota families, then I’m your guy.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjQ5NzZ9AAwAAAAAAoBFmCIFE_oEdzL8IGkA0sEj7KG0NUsRjpGgrjfYodtf37KRylCajUt_Fl3eF5iKK-L2dlqbBaLk0ywVIQSw6mD_gHVnD77XNhP9xgFa7w)**

subject: The margin of error
body:
What just happened in North Carolina.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1163&source=&t=1&akid=2862%2E124072%2EPIzJ_v)

---
There’s been a huge development in the race, Peter. Let me explain.
**As I write this, the GOP is going all in to defeat me.** President Trump has endorsed my MAGA opponent and personally attacked me on social media, Stephen Miller recently went on Fox News to rant and rave about me and super PACs are putting hundreds of millions behind baseless ads lying about who I am and what I’m fighting for.
They’re coming after me so hard because they know that if they can just defeat us, it won’t matter what happens in other swing states. If the GOP wins NC, that’s the ballgame – they’ll likely keep U.S. Senate control until 2029.
Unfortunately, these attacks are working.**A brand-new poll out this morning shows that this race is once again statistically tied.**
This comes just a few weeks after the Senate GOP's top super PAC launched new TV ads all across the state, which they had originally planned to start airing in _September._
They’re spending more in North Carolina than any other battleground in the country, and the polls show that their investments are paying off.
**I need your help, Peter. We’re getting outspent, and without your immediate grassroots support, we could put our shot at flipping this seat at risk.[_So if you care about winning in North Carolina and retaking the Senate, making a well-timed donation of $5 to my campaign today is the best thing you can do to help me fight back, protect our narrowing lead and win. Peter,

**Landmark Legal Foundation has been on the front lines of several legal cases supporting President Trump 's agenda.**

_**Trump v. Anderson**_
The Colorado Supreme Court attempted to prevent Donald Trump from appearing on the ballot in 2024 by weaponizing a provision in the 14th Amendment that prohibited those who had engaged in insurrection from holding office.

**We fought this at the Supreme Court, which ruled 9-0 that the Colorado court erred.**

_**United States v. Trump**_
Landmark was one of the only groups fighting against Jack Smith's prosecution of Donald Trump. We argued that, because his appointment had not been confirmed by the Senate, he lacked the authority to bring charges against Trump.

**Judge Aileen Cannon ordered a hearing on this question and,_after hearing our argument_ , dismissed Smith's charges.**

_**Trump v. Slaughter**_
We urged the Supreme Court to overturn Humphrey's Executor, a 1935 decision that ruled that federal employees who exercised "quasi-legislative" or "quasi-judicial" functions could not be fired by the President.

By protecting the heads of independent agencies from accountability to the President, Humphrey's Executor undermines the system of checks and balances designed by our Framers.

**In a historic victory for constitutional separation of powers, the Supreme Court overturned Humphrey 's Executor.**

At least 34 universal injunctions (and counting) have been issued against Trump's second-term policies. Landmark Legal Foundation has been by President Trump's side all the way, and we will keep fighting to ensure that the lawfare from activist judges does not interfere with the President's ability to serve the American people. ---
| | The question that has hung over the summer — whether the energy shock would finally crack the American consumer — got a clear, troubling answer this week. Retail sales fell 0.6% in the latest report, a sharp miss against a consensus that expected a gain of 0.1% to 0.3%, and preliminary August consumer sentiment printed at just 51.0. **After months of resilience against four consecutive months of inflation outpacing wages, the consumer has visibly weakened — the clearest sign yet that the summer’s $4.09 gasoline and elevated prices are curbing household spending.**
---
| | For your portfolio, the 0.6% decline is significant because of the gap between expectation and result. A market expecting a modest gain got a contraction — a swing of roughly a full percentage point from consensus that signals the weakness arrived faster and harder than economists anticipated. **The depressed sentiment reading of 51.0 reinforces it: consumers are spending less and feeling worse, suggesting genuine financial strain rather than temporary caution.** This is the transmission mechanism to watch: the four-month erosion of real wages, compounded by $4 gasoline, finally showing up in spending. A weakening consumer shifts the risk from the inflation side toward the growth side — the energy shock becoming a growth problem, the stagflationary bind. For the American investor at or near retirement, this warrants a genuine response. The balanced posture held partly on consumer strength; that pillar has cracked. Lean more defensive on consumer-cyclical sectors: trim consumer discretionary and retail-dependent names, add defensive quality and staples that hold up in a spending slowdown. The consumer crack is the first hard evidence the stagflation scenario is gaining ground over the soft landing — the answer is turning toward caution.

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is now FREE on DVD.

In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the president of Hillsdale College, Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.

Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

You'll explore these relationships in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**To receive your FREE Genesis DVD box set, please use the secure link here:**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/-genesis-free-dvd-offer](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcGOnDAQRL_G3ECmYcBz4JAIiBJlJ0rmkKPlcTfQkrEtbGZ_P1pp9gdyrSe9kqr-vuk3w479ejM7DZySxoA6b3SQM5mDTxvHB-V3Ir8G1CChK6UqAbSxmZ-kW1PgcIFaLaqgoe5V30pZXy_FNnSm61Au6mKaK1ijVN2StJcWjOof2FPBw4dPKoAaZFND9QC0sgd1Xaw1i7SilWdEk6linxgp2RBiDI4z21SFYy3csOUck2i-CJgFzOyXUG3sXELjqCI8BczlSp4Sp3I5iEp8YhmWhQ7RzMmKZpTy2nY3CS38_PF1_DVO011Ad-Zdp3AelkQzxiOkSDazX19oJ-RzF81Iu2H3Cq3Zo-HVi2Z8VWp84icMPpPPohm_Tbfp_v0-_5km_bsv607KsfycojgGjO_sHKeuF61cP_yVDXuR__eg5wD_AgAA__8_KKCA)

body:
Cook Political Report just moved Texas AND Iowa to toss-up on the same day.

| | |
---
| | | Fellow Conservative, The Cook Political Report, the nonpartisan gold standard of election forecasting, just did something I need you to see. They moved Texas from "Lean Republican" to "Toss-Up." Then they moved Iowa from "Lean Republican" to "Toss-Up." _Both. Same day. Less than 75 days before the election._ Cook's own analysis said it plainly: in a wave election, even states that President Trump won by double digits could move within Democrats' reach. That's what they're seeing in Texas and Iowa right now.[ ](https://trk.email.tedcruz._AmTD6rxrP2g) Let that sink in. President Trump won both of these states by double-digit margins in 2024. And today, the nonpartisan scorekeepers looked at the data and said: coin flip.[ ](https://trk.email.tedcruz._zessnCaqRTx0P4C_Q) Here's why. James Talarico raised nearly **$30 million on ActBlue over the last three months.** He has been spending his millions of dollars on ads in Texas for months. He has Schumer's full backing, the DSA machine behind him, and more cash than any Democrat Senate candidate in Texas history. In Iowa, Ashley Hinson is facing a well-funded Democrat challenger in a race that has shifted further left than anyone predicted. **Two races. Two toss-ups. And Cook now sees the entire battle for the Senate as a toss-up with Republicans holding only the slimmest of advantages.** I want to be direct with you about what this means. If we lose Texas and Iowa, both states Donald Trump won by double digits and Chuck Schumer has his majority. Your taxes go up. The border opens. Conservative judges get blocked._Everything we've fought for in the last two years gets reversed._ **_This is not a hypothetical. This is the forecast. Right now. Today._** I am fighting for both of these races personally. I need your help on both fronts and I want to make it easy. **When you chip in today, your gift will be automatically split between Ashley Hinson in Iowa and Ken Paxton in Texas -- two races, one donation, maximum impact.** **[[LINK]](https://trk.email.tedcruz._R40Bp-nI8AZyXRxA)** **[[FIGHT ON TWO FRONTS->]](https://trk.email.tedcruz.)** Less than 75 days. Did you know that your county government can sell your delinquent property-tax debt to a private investor?
The county gets paid. The investor gets the right to collect the debt, charge interest, and potentially foreclose on your home.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/fdc349d2-586e-41d0-b81a-598692ab54c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
You can start with a property-tax bill you cannot afford and end up fighting to keep the roof over your head while a private company makes money from your hardship.
That is what is happening in Ohio.
I recently spoke with [Jasson Farrier, the Ohio Housing Nerd](https://substack.com/redirect/d5d822f2-6b38-4ccd-99b0-e4400b642685?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), about Ohio's property-tax crisis and the private companies buying delinquent tax certificates from county governments.
Jasson is a realtor and real-estate investor who has spent months investigating property-tax delinquencies across Ohio. He is trying to answer a basic question: If so many Ohioans are falling behind on their property taxes, where are all the tax foreclosures?
The answer, at least in some counties, is that the county has already been paid.
The homeowner's debt has been sold.

---
These boxes aren't sitting around waiting for someone to need them.

They're already claimed. And we don't have extras.

By the time one batch goes out, more requests come in.

Different schools, different students, same situation -- they want to start something, and they're asking us to help them do it.

That's where things stand right now.

We have more students stepping up than we can fully support at the moment.

And I don't say that lightly.

Because for years, the challenge wasn't getting students the tools -- it was getting them to speak up at all. Most kept their heads down.

The Left has spent years trying to convince this generation to sit down, stay quiet, and be ashamed of their country and everything that makes it great.

And for a long time, it worked. But that's all changing.

Now, we're seeing students stand up and push back.

**We saw it clearly at Wheeling High School in the Chicago suburbs -- Charlie's alma mater. **

For the first time, students there launched a Club America chapter. It took months to get approved, but a chapter is finally there.

And now, students are standing outside with signs about free markets and freedom -- not because it's easy, but because they've decided it matters more than staying quiet.

But if you zoom out, there are roughly 27,000 high schools in America.

That means tens of thousands of campuses where the Left still dominates the conversation...

And where students are waiting for someone to help them stand up and speak.

So as much as this has grown, we're still in the early innings of what Charlie actually set out to build.

✅ Arkansas
✅ Florida

✅ Indiana

We're not lacking interest or momentum.

We're working to keep up with both.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Dealing with the Data Center Backlash
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/july4th-12854509?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
Southaven’s Mayor, Darren Musselwhite, is right.

[Last week he told his aldermen that the data center development coming](https://us.list-manage.com/BliqEUa6KHq?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3) to his north Mississippi city carries national security implications. He called it patriotic. He pointed out that it will bring millions of dollars into the community, and he said it will rank among the most significant economic developments in DeSoto County’s history.

He is right on every count. He is also making that case against the wind.

Because there is a backlash against data centers, and it is growing.

It could be, as the mayor suggests, that the big companies have not done a good enough job of explaining what they are doing, or of showing the neighborhoods around them how they stand to benefit. Perhaps.

But I suspect this is bigger than a communications problem. AI data centers are turning into a live political issue heading into the midterms, with voters across party lines telling pollsters they are worried about higher utility bills and about strained water and power supplies.

Most alarming of all, I saw Texas Governor Greg Abbott boasting on X that his directive has halted up to 1,800 data center projects.
---
|
---
| Now, if I had been a fly on the wall when Abbott’s team decided to send that, I suspect the thinking ran something like this. Issue a directive insisting that data centers must not take water needed by local communities, must not take power needed by the grid, and must not push up the cost of electricity — safe in the knowledge that data centers do not actually do any of those things. On that reading, an anti-data-center tweet is political positioning rather than a substantive move against them.

Maybe so. What worries me is what it concedes.

Once a Republican governor of Texas has publicly stamped on data centers for being water-hungry, for raising power prices and for disrupting rural communities, it becomes that much harder for anyone else to show that they do not.

We conservatives need to think through our policy response — and quickly.

Which is why I was so excited to see Grover Norquist of Americans for Tax Reform propose a brilliant idea.

States, he suggests, should require that the tax payments made by data centers go to reduce property taxes at the local level, and income taxes at the state level.
---
|
---
| Why is Grover’s suggestion so wonderful?

Because there is a danger in what is coming. Look at Madison County, where Amazon’s data centers are projected to send around $14 million to the county, its schools and its community college in 2027 — rising to roughly $145 million a year by 2033. That is an extraordinary injection of money into a single county.

And extraordinary injections of money have a habit of growing local government. There is a real danger that some municipal government somewhere decides to turn 1970s Scandinavian.

Much better if those proceeds go on paying down property taxes instead.

That shows a real benefit to a real community. High property taxes are unfair on everyone, but they fall hardest on older folk on fixed incomes. We have arrived at a crazy situation in which a family that has finished paying for its home is essentially having to lease that property back from local and state government for as long as they live in it.

Grover’s idea does something else, too. It helps mayors like Darren Musselwhite. Instead of asking a neighborhood to take a development on trust, he could point at a smaller tax bill and say: there it is.

As luck would have it, Grover Norquist is coming to speak at our annual Gala in a couple of months, where you can hear him expand on this excellent idea. [Buy your ticket here](https://us.list-manage.com/1CbnjSJVve3?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3).
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://us.list-manage.com/134cjb0Q0aW?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO
Mississippi Center for Public Policy
---
|
---

Mississippi Center for Public Policy520 George StJackson, MS 39202-3013

body:
The Navy (almost certainly at Hegseth and Trump’s direction) is considering renaming the carrier USS Doris Miller after Donald Trump.
#
Making sure you saw yesterday’s email.
The Navy (almost certainly at Hegseth and Trump’s direction) is considering renaming the carrier USS Doris Miller after Donald Trump. Miller is one of the first heroes of WWII, and we’re _sure_ it’s just a coincidence that this would be the first carrier named for a Black enlisted sailor.
The USS Doris Miller is one of several new Ford class aircraft carriers, this one scheduled for delivery by 2032. It’s important to note the word scheduled, because Trump has pushed for ridiculous and substantial design changes on the carriers because he doesn’t like the way they look. And just to name it, this is coming after he and Hegseth said that the sailors aboard the USS Lincoln were lying about the conditions onboard after being deployed for more than 260 days.
So, not only is he calling sailors in harm’s way liars, not only is he driving up development time and costs by years and billions of dollars, he’s elevating himself above a fallen American hero by replacing Doris Miller’s name with his own.
If you’re infuriated by this, you’re not alone. Yesterday, thousands of people signed our petition to stop Trump from renaming the USS Doris Miller for himself. Today, we’re asking you to join them.
[**Add your name and help us make sure Trump’s name never gets painted on the hull of that aircraft carrier.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260822-1-360&refcode2=35494.3013755.yxAYbe&akid=35494%2E3013755%2EyxAYbe)
| [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260822-1-360&refcode2=35494.3013755.yxAYbe&akid=35494%2E3013755%2EyxAYbe)
---
Thank you. Yesterday’s email with additional information on Doris Miller is below:
* * *
Peter:
On December 7th, 1941, a mess attendant named Doris Miller was serving aboard the battleship West Virginia in Pearl Harbor. His job was one of just a few available to Black sailors in the segregated military. He served breakfast to the other sailors that morning, when around 0800 the West Virginia was struck by the first of seven torpedoes.
Miller reported to battlestations. The ship’s Captain, Mervyn Bennion, was wounded in the first attack, and Miller helped carry him to shelter. Because of the color of his skin, Miller was never given a chance to train on any of the ship’s weapons. Two of his shipmates trained him to operate anti-aircraft weapons on the fly, and he started firing. He fired until he ran out of ammunition, and was credited with shooting down two enemy aircraft.
The ship, struck repeatedly by armor piercing bombs and torpedoes, was leaking oil. Fire spread, smoke engulfing the conning tower. Miller then helped carry Captain Bennion out of the smoke, up to the navigation bridge. He went on to move more injured sailors out of the oil and water to the deck.
In 1942, bills were introduced in the House and Senate to award Miller the Medal of Honor, but the Secretary of the Navy recommended against it. Miller ultimately received the Navy Cross, and went back into active service in the Pacific. In 1943 he was aboard the carrier Liscome Bay when it was struck by a torpedo. The ship went down in less than a half hour, and Miller’s body was never found.
Doris Miller is a hero to all Americans... but not to Pete Hegseth and Donald Trump.
[](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260822-1-360&refcode2=35494.3013755.yxAYbe&akid=35494%2E3013755%2EyxAYbe)
Yeah, that’s complete bullshit. We’re not going to let it happen.
[**Peter, add your name _immediately_ and demand that the carrier CVN-81, the USS Doris Miller, NEVER be named after a draft-dodger who insults Veterans, the fallen, and their families. A disgrace who directed an attack on the US Capitol, started an illegal war, and got Americans killed. A coward who has trampled the graves of the fallen at Arlington, and wants to put them in his shadow by building a 250 foot tall arch, dedicated entirely to himself.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/Aug_VV_doris_miller_em/?source=em260822-1-360&refcode2=35494.3013755.yxAYbe&akid=35494%2E3013755%2EyxAYbe)

So, not only is he calling sailors in harm’s way liars, not only is he driving up development time and costs by years and billions of dollars, he’s elevating himself above a fallen American hero by replacing Doris Miller’s name with his own. If you’re infuriated by this, you’re not alone. Yesterday, thousands of people signed our petition to stop Trump from renaming the USS Doris Miller for himself. Today, we’re asking you to join them. | Thank you. Yesterday’s email with additional information on Doris Miller is below: * Peter: On December 7th, 1941, a mess attendant named Doris Miller was serving aboard the battleship West Virginia in Pearl Harbor. His job was one of just a few available to Black sailors in the segregated military. He served breakfast to the other sailors that morning, when around 0800 the West Virginia was struck by the first of seven torpedoes. Miller reported to battlestations. The ship’s Captain, Mervyn Bennion, was wounded in the first attack, and Miller helped carry him to shelter. Because of the color of his skin, Miller was never given a chance to train on any of the ship’s weapons. Two of his shipmates trained him to operate anti-aircraft weapons on the fly, and he started firing. He fired until he ran out of ammunition, and was credited with shooting down two enemy aircraft. The ship, struck repeatedly by armor piercing bombs and torpedoes, was leaking oil. Fire spread, smoke engulfing the conning tower. Miller then helped carry Captain Bennion out of the smoke, up to the navigation bridge. He went on to move more injured sailors out of the oil and water to the deck. In 1942, bills were introduced in the House and Senate to award Miller the Medal of Honor, but the Secretary of the Navy recommended against it. Miller ultimately received the Navy Cross, and went back into active service in the Pacific. In 1943 he was aboard the carrier Liscome Bay when it was struck by a torpedo. The ship went down in less than a half hour, and Miller’s body was never found. Doris Miller is a hero to all Americans... but not to Pete Hegseth and Donald Trump. Yeah, that’s complete bullshit. Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | The cameras were locked on Trump... subject: We can't surrender our libraries
body:
And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish.
| | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=05cc1ea991004e22828293f2cfd43c94&_e=1lDdSD3-FwawKbGWJtM5orXf2MeNF1I0lL6d6nkSA2r7gTdNXCdaRC3c6vg_XAfkNG_hY1eAmCptyJD45BoHu-szUD9o0Cc407gGjtmL0YG9extakVPo8ruPw8GJxMWcxCsvAFVm7JYkWrPOtOJupd7rYDg0dM3skrfjwfsiIVbrlpDZK5l5zdZFIx9G2ZYFPMV5CRDAtap8wYXIBsZ6WxYrKWPVvoHbNwugAVxzm5fthofTA-DHsbQ78373bgLnE8UtESLIG4q5ieYp31jnC6-4tECfWlMdD8ULyYdpAuGb0JlswIfRtECA53pNdddZvtfOvsLOwrABEp6-gxhtJ9JwD9fPvULNguFiBSYSIfH-5Fr9nxlA3Gp-ziSdZsqwkePBKVmkL425wWTowMv4ercxQQt1YuGQmFYzX16Cx_n03QGc44f7Y4exVrNuJkpDlCqyZtxXTIOXrK9txW3gpqK7ma7mmVD9ZV7v9IkrcqaGuOVL7IEJIzi27cESy5dom3tgozX9kMF8eOMO4m1PLrg5pyfj28QiD7Y2cqobdzY6aS4thAJdp8PEomqwBlzAhYx2tl1l0ATSIwNjaq53ulTjC3akAWrw5iVcjtvmun3YnU6Br_4S1de8e0AH3VjLAlKhdoY865Xw8WKpP1vkq12SYduXAsw4DMKdQHV3oxSPX8OtauGll37Rahl1CEdJ)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.**But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour”
---
**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=05cc1ea991004e22828293f2cfd43c94&_e=1lDdSD3-FwawKbGWJtM5orXf2MeNF1I0lL6d6nkSA2r7gTdNXCdaRC3c6vg_XAfkNG_hY1eAmCptyJD45BoHu-szUD9o0Cc407gGjtmL0YG9extakVPo8ruPw8GJxMWcxCsvAFVm7JYkWrPOtOJupd7rYDg0dM3skrfjwfsiIVbrlpDZK5l5zdZFIx9G2ZYFPMV5CRDAtap8wYXIBsZ6WxYrKWPVvoHbNwugAVxzm5c9gEprbvSJE6UOhreABcten15c4nceMp0CfM7Z7LfO7F1kuB1oRJjKzbDphSLx3MlWG_6-DmvsIsTrY2M5p7A-mZPLne9FIh9sX1m3NXqhBXVLq_kRs_qBXle-jJZ9q_UKyR8JDyVPiBIbFxf2pOLr1GjTrxfhe_jsnkPbV-H5ykp2anafYBPaaDFISEuBFDWKPAenEl-dV42Fut7JAsMMjZd87OcGc44Uyh9rCrbSs4w2Vdzq6mKO1Qh0KAT8mef5P3sjlmc42Hfq0dwH0uylvJ11IeGO2s43bOYkxC80XxUOAPfAVELhOeibOL1A8Ati6ft8Iy1_LmYvN43Xb1EGO1UFz2Hqk-byIcpj9KFUpNIVsGCGHX-Lbax59hwaCKuTWaRSD3sm6sI0uTw8rBuZXNqsP8hSOM-UMQiOcZmL5junSwQeI3SpLS2dfwRzOdeVfWfG-auBf8u3AnslB2qc)** For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. **And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.** Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.**But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.**But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=05cc1ea991004e22828293f2cfd43c94&_e=1lDdSD3-FwawKbGWJtM5orXf2MeNF1I0lL6d6nkSA2r7gTdNXCdaRC3c6vg_XAfkNG_hY1eAmCptyJD45BoHu-szUD9o0Cc407gGjtmL0YG9extakVPo8ruPw8GJxMWcxCsvAFVm7JYkWrPOtOJupd7rYDg0dM3skrfjwfsiIVbrlpDZK5l5zdZFIx9G2ZYFPMV5CRDAtap8wYXIBsZ6WxYrKWPVvoHbNwugAVxzm5cL6Y3YJm6YjVodsJkNv49Z1BDIv6WzGtop-NWxxS83O4KAKVNb26FzFKof_r7OypYWgITRizaoL-D2yO97EYEB9_7DcMF4USl-fknTO3FDU1_KGbP307aQyLcZDkn_swh1NmmWwSML4jEentQ_s0UaCxzvoQfE8TCJdLfG80NYLLi1Mawuq45akC7YzLBiet6vqpnGDjhLqMStFaU-ytG7ekgu6ApgUoVjTJkfSMzkL8lplX1EZNpE2GcaP8QrEPAP3jTyw22TOW7rcesQCtOzPFHt5X3uSfLGTFDFbtZGprHEG_a3Yc08foNn9IyP-Q6RV1gNENoZYhdHCWVBkEkj51CVwqxaPLZf1qp1pu8IC2jWZ57R9WvkRgwSd__GND4U1xXqbO4vLAoq1Zl1htUheYQpuQtHThzeuTdHUlwm0Q6pkG-lB_X3zMXs8-U3_bH8fauE3uSVbh7jzkHwN5_4) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.**Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.**And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.**And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.** It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. **[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=05cc1ea991004e22828293f2cfd43c94&_e=1lDdSD3-FwawKbGWJtM5orXf2MeNF1I0lL6d6nkSA2r7gTdNXCdaRC3c6vg_XAfkNG_hY1eAmCptyJD45BoHu-szUD9o0Cc407gGjtmL0YG9extakVPo8ruPw8GJxMWcxCsvAFVm7JYkWrPOtOJupd7rYDg0dM3skrfjwfsiIVbrlpDZK5l5zdZFIx9G2ZYFPMV5CRDAtap8wYXIBsZ6WxYrKWPVvoHbNwugAVxzm5dcXEafSuGc7UD-q3z2wagS2HvSmjDTDsNAov6wrwR7v-Lxyreen_2ljUbpZy_8OuKkZ6fq3Oa_Zg6Ct9VqdnmVdZHDNzifJwMTrpdbyV6d7og2YFB3oeF897rhyPzqiH-n3tnzuw4I4A0ZVveqfyPLOq3nB-d2I46Ijm-sl7MHx-SstJ-e9YTW6fy8Kl69hQ_yVLW86BHV25BDNIvAbX-Dx8Fc_B4y_rZ55julNNxLgFYHU3e6qx_8VmtA8lWrks3faKznjP84NuIXjQYg3AJvCtqNdMLI0jPWcMgqXcMskYpku5sBTLOtuFzlHbcgzeSY5wUNLjl26oo5in8pnVOUcn5FmThCLL5CQ8yPXT49ZxdG42fbLX_KUpLFLqHwaJcnMpmBttONPXyG0A-WjPoC4FFcX8lWiqR_OGMjH6SdOdXaRJC3XYFbxwNLYMZK1i1khq9aouxEbUIPd31--SXB)** The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these clean_body: And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. | | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. - BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,Kirk Cameron | | | 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301
