body:
Peter,

Donald Trump, Mike Rogers’ team, and MAGA Republicans have started using
my full name — Abdulrahman Mohamed El-Sayed — like it's a weapon. Like the
extra syllables are supposed to make you trust me less.

I think that says more about them than it does about me. That’s because
when you don't have a record to run on, you run on fear instead.

Mike Rogers voted to raise his own pay, took over a million dollars from
opioid makers and Wall Street banks, and cashed in for millions the moment
he left Congress.

MAGA Republicans know Michiganders won't vote for that record. So instead,
they’re hoping they'll vote against my name.

Peter, I've spent
my whole life being relatively young, relatively brown, and relatively
Muslim. Their attacks don’t faze me one bit.

What does worry me is the MAGA billionaire network working in the
background to prop up Rogers.

Facts are facts, and it’s clear that Mike Rogers is a weak candidate. But
Trump handpicked him, so now, Republicans have to do and spend whatever it
takes to get Rogers across the finish line.

That’s why $51 million in GOP Super PAC money has already been committed

_As a mother who 's passionate about youth sports, I felt the urge to intervene._I didn't go for the publicity... I went to stand up for something I'm passionate about and am prepared to staunchly defend.When I first launched this campaign for U.S. Senate in Minnesota, _I knew I would have to prepare myself and my family for the pain and vitriol that would be slung my way._**But, never in my wildest dreams would I imagine something so basic to be the cause of such heated debate. Biology isn 't complicated. Women are born with a specific set of chromosomes. So are men. They're different.

**That's why we have women's divisions in sports, so women can compete on a fair playing field.

And every roster is finite. Every team excludes someone. That's not bigotry, that's how sports work.

subject: He said "take over the voting." Now he's doing it.

body:
Fired the referees. Sent in his own watchers. Threatened the people who count the votes.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/125796?t=6&akid=27979%2E878179%2EwvNM06) Friend,

Donald Trump fired every remaining commissioner of the federal agency that helps states run secure elections.

By email. Effective immediately. Just months before the midterms.

Days earlier, his Justice Department announced it was deploying election monitors to battleground states and Democratic strongholds — and threatened election officials in all 50 states with criminal prosecution.

**Fired the referees. Sent in his own watchers. Threatened the people who count the votes.**

I spent years as a federal prosecutor. I know a pattern of intent when I see one. This isn't election security — it's an attempt to seize control of our elections before a single ballot is cast.

There is one check on his abuse of power that Trump cannot fire and cannot intimidate: a Democratic Senate.

That's why we're scaling up our operations right now — expanding the infrastructure it will take to hold him accountable and retake the Senate.

body:
Peter, I'm retiring from Congress, and I honestly expected more.
I'm not angry, I'm just disappointed. A few days ago, I sent out the signal calling on every conservative patriot in the nation to help me secure my legacy and rescue this seat from the Democrat vultures.
But nothing happened.
No cavalry came. As I prepare to step down, it felt like I was left to fight the entire Democratic Party by myself. For a moment, I actually feared for the future of the MAGA movement.
But then I remembered, YOU never let us down, Peter. You are the reason for our historic victories, and I know you would never turn your back on this movement, especially now that I am passing the torch to the next generation.

The EMILYs List team _\----------Original Message---------

I feel it in my bones: The stars are aligning for the political upset of the century.
You heard me right, I firmly believe that this campaign has the power to make HISTORY by defeating Mike Johnson in November.
What's got me feeling so optimistic?
Yesterday alone, three Trump-endorsed Republicans lost their primaries. Not one. Not two. Three, in a single day. That is not a fluke that can be waved away.

| I'm out here every single day, at the doors, looking real people in the eye, and I am telling you -- voters are furious. They're exhausted. They watched this administration launch an expensive, unpopular war instead of fighting for them. They watched Medicaid get gutted and got told, with a straight face, that it was about "waste, fraud, and abuse."
The voters are done being lied to.
My opponent, Mike Johnson is the head of the snake. Every rotten piece of this agenda runs straight through him.
Here's what I need you to understand: Even here, in his home district, people are done. I mean DONE. Fed up, sick and tired, whatever verbiage you want to use - the fact of the matter is Mike Johnson isn't getting the job done, and voters know it.
There is a wave of change breaking across the South right now, and I truly believe this district can be the place it crashes hardest. I can feel it building. I will not let us waste it.
This is our moment. Right now.
[Will you chip in $50, $25, or even just $10 today to help us defeat Mike Johnson? # Saturday, August 22, 2026

| Just The Truth| | Estimated Read Time: 3 Minutes

Just The Truth Your No-BS Newsletter
Dear Readers, Today’s message highlights an important battle for life that is increasingly taking place online. As abortion pills become more accessible, PreBorn! is asking supporters to help bring a real person into the conversation and help a mother see that she has another path forward. Thank you for your consideration of our sponsors.
The Just The Truth Team
| | [](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.Tq3vNBNbAcE-_uCwSL6GEpRjiBDsLc6-qoxTuNXfinG5E2nc4qSrcu164AfznRDaxPb7JST74iuWHkHHhnXj4WLF2dBDT5YLgOv37XsfKAR1qZ8Zb7j-6wt0tZAVRQE-W-W3JNaw8z3SIpiOmwkbFxm5ZdAhlX0nryjnsCL-PF8GvqiB9SygzuD8JhdgdfSRv8CHI3TIh08x0Tr6buBbpAAa8kLjgXZTOkgVwYg4uXmwtJ8yrSiSc_DkkvsMjJBe4wpW6emFvjyjC-zZe8PqFIN_GDLMb7FWojiFOiDmj9A/4te/RbxlfWV_R9aKpL92i0-ZHg/h1/h001.VZHt_5YOa8O5AhIfQ3yDJ0fLVfbNRzN2VH5phFbOGGo)
---
Dear Friend of Life, **It can cost the abortion industry as little as $5 to get in front of a woman searching online for abortion pills.** That should stop us in our tracks. Imagine a woman who has just discovered she is pregnant. She wasn’t expecting this. She may be worried about money, insurance, child care, or how she could possibly have this baby. She is frightened, overwhelmed, and looking for someone to tell her what to do next. So she reaches for her phone. Within moments, she can find an abortion provider ready to sell her pills that will end her pregnancy and the life of her baby—all without ever walking into an abortion facility. **But what if she found hope instead?** PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Our Network Clinics across America provide free ultrasounds to women facing unexpected pregnancies. When a mother has the opportunity to see her baby and hear the heartbeat, what once felt like an impossible situation can suddenly look very different. But the way women are making decisions about abortion has changed. **Approximately 70% of abortions now happen through abortion pills.** Today, we cannot simply wait and hope a frightened mother walks through the doors of a pregnancy clinic. If women are going online looking for abortion, **we have to reach them there—and we have to reach them first.** That is why PreBorn! is expanding our reach through our Virtual Care System. Through this innovative approach, we can reach women while they are looking online for answers and create an opportunity for them to connect with something profoundly different from the abortion industry: **A real person who cares about her and her baby.** A registered nurse can listen to what she is facing without judgment, answer her questions, provide pregnancy education, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic where she can receive an ultrasound and continued support. And when welcomed, our nurses can pray with these women and offer them the eternal hope of Jesus Christ. Friend of Life, think about the difference. The abortion industry is prepared to meet a frightened woman online and sell her pills to end the life of her baby. [**PreBorn! wants to meet her with a compassionate human being who will slow down, listen to what she is facing, and help her discover another path forward with her baby.**](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.Tq3vNBNbAcE-_uCwSL6GEpRjiBDsLc6-qoxTuNXfinG5E2nc4qSrcu164AfznRDaxPb7JST74iuWHkHHhnXj4WLF2dBDT5YLgOv37XsfKAR1qZ8Zb7j-6wt0tZAVRQE-W-W3JNaw8z3SIpiOmwkbFxm5ZdAhlX0nryjnsCL-PF8GvqiB9SygzuD8JhdgdfSRv8CHI3TIh08x0Tr6buBbpAAa8kLjgXZTOkgVwYg4uXkW2lHZsChgObsm01SROUOdeEbrZWNO2rIoQ3lwNXNuBElkGkB7sIjGhzWtbh2Qbbs/4te/RbxlfWV_R9aKpL92i0-ZHg/h2/h001.GFsv7vVsFzRTq5gKgz86FlUcYTE0WaShyyGmwb6WgJ4) That is the opportunity your generosity can help put in front of her. Right now, **our goal is to reach 500 women facing unexpected pregnancies by August 31** and give them the opportunity to connect with compassionate, life-affirming care before abortion becomes their answer. Will you help us reach them?
---
[](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.Tq3vNBNbAcE-_uCwSL6GEpRjiBDsLc6-qoxTuNXfinG5E2nc4qSrcu164AfznRDaxPb7JST74iuWHkHHhnXj4WLF2dBDT5YLgOv37XsfKAR1qZ8Zb7j-6wt0tZAVRQE-W-W3JNaw8z3SIpiOmwkbFxm5ZdAhlX0nryjnsCL-PF8GvqiB9SygzuD8JhdgdfSRv8CHI3TIh08x0Tr6buBbpAAa8kLjgXZTOkgVwYg4uXlHsSoWI_l1opgBI0TT2SDT4p_Rp5d0XvYE-g-WvZ3D5ksUO7wk_KTd4C0fSI6D9SQ/4te/RbxlfWV_R9aKpL92i0-ZHg/h3/h001.2FGakpWBgeUk2P6pimtJho9a5SSQ90Or2ktHgcWfP6A)

Your gift of **$25, $50, $100, $200, or any amount** can help put hope in the path of women who are looking online for answers right now. You may never know the name of the woman your gift helps reach. But somewhere today, she could be sitting alone with her phone in her hand, frightened about what comes next. **And the abortion industry is already waiting for her.** What she finds in that moment matters. Before an abortion provider has the opportunity to convince her that ending the life of her baby is the answer, your gift can help put something very different in her path—a real nurse who cares, an ultrasound where she can see her baby, practical support, and the hope of Jesus Christ. **Abortion is only a click away. Hope should be, too.** Please give today and help PreBorn! reach 500 women by August 31.

---
| | **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137736838/641768107/1363299629?refcode=EM_BS_LUR_260822_FR_Chutzpah_A0_na_U1_X2_M1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDA3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NWNiNTBjMy02NDllLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AWeGr4r9VUnmCSxzA4IVa6LsTIoAWwiIvdLMfnDneuw=)**_Chutzpah_ — a Yiddish term that means _guts or courage._ In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama. That took some serious _chutzpah_. My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind. That promise came true for him, and for generations of my family. That’s what sets America apart. Here, anyone with a little _chutzpah_ is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed. In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms. In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them. In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous. In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened. In 2026, I’m the Democratic nominee for VA-02, because Jen Kiggans either _can’t or won’t_ protect them. The fact is that Hampton Roads is in crisis. Our community’s been hit hard by this president’s failed agenda. **It's time for a leader with _chutzpah_.** VA-02 is rated a Toss-Up, and dark money groups and super PACs are circling. This will be one of the toughest, costliest fights of the entire 2026 election cycle. Luckily, _chutzpah_ runs in my family, and I’m not afraid of a little mishigas. With you behind me, I’m ready to be the unapologetic champion Virginia families need. In 1906, my great-grandfather left his home in Poland, made the long journey through Europe and across the Atlantic, and landed in Jasper, Alabama. That took some serious chutzpah. My great-grandfather believed so strongly in the promise of America – a place where he could be Jewish without fear, where he could forge his own path – that he left his whole world behind. That promise came true for him, and for generations of my family. That’s what sets America apart. Here, anyone with a little chutzpah is free to be whoever they want to be, do whatever they want to do, and achieve more than they ever dreamed. In 1993, I joined the Navy to defend those freedoms. In 2018, I ran for Congress to expand them. In 2020, I won re-election to continue that work, making our nation free, safe, and prosperous. In 2022, I served on the January 6th Committee because our Constitutional freedoms were threatened. | The largest energy source on Earth has been sitting right below our feet.

Not in the Middle East. Not in a mine. Not at the bottom of the ocean.

Three miles straight down, everywhere on the planet.

The International Energy Agency measured it at 140 times global electricity demand. It never runs out. Never stops. Produces zero emissions.

The only problem was getting to it.

For decades, nobody could drill deep enough through solid rock to make it work.

Last year, a crew punched through in 16 days. The government said it would take 64.

Beloved classics like _The Wind in the Willows_ , _Treasure Island_ , and _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ are just a few of the foundational books that are rarely being taught to our nation's children today. Not only does this rob young people of classic tales of adventure and friendship, but they also rob children of fundamental lessons about the world and how best to live.

MAGA’s only hope of raising those additional funds is through the generous support of grassroots donors like YOU , Friend. I know you’ve already done a lot to support the President and his Majority. If you can’t afford to give any more or you’ve already given all that you can, I completely understand. Just disregard my request, and please make sure you turn out and vote on (or before) November 3rd! But if you can spare even just $5 to help us FIGHT BACK against the Democrats in these 12 races, it would help us out a lot. Every dollar truly makes a difference. Losing even ONE of these seats could be the final blow that topples our House Majority... Thank you, Rep. According to the headlines, the American economy is doing fine. Not great, not terrible, but fine. [GDP grew 2.0% in Q1 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/cdfd2231-576e-4761-a47d-e43393157191?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Employment seems stable-ish. Inflation, while still above the Fed's 2% target, looks like its moderating. The [CBO projects continued economic expansion](https://substack.com/redirect/9e6a23f1-abba-43d3-a954-b6c96fa0f251?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through the end of the year. Consumer spending is holding up, particularly at the upper end. The stock market is near all-time highs. Corporate earnings are strong, especially in tech.
Yet despite this news, most Americans are worried. Consumer confidence is far from ebullient. And the US economy is shed more jobs than it created in July. I've spent a career looking past headlines and connecting seemingly irrelevant and disparate dots. And the mosaic I'm putting together is forming a deeply concerning image.
* * *
## [AI Infrastructure: Boom or Bust?](https://substack.com/redirect/04bd6848-031d-4dad-bcd3-f4fad6be6316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Vikram Mansharamani](https://substack.com/profile/37278065-vikram-mansharamani)| | *

| Mar 29
[](https://substack.com/redirect/04bd6848-031d-4dad-bcd3-f4fad6be6316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[In the late 1990s, Lucent Technologies was America's most widely held stock -- a "picks and shovels" play on the internet revolution. The company lent billions to its own customers so they could buy more Lucent equipment. On paper, revenue soared. In reality, Lucent was financing its own demand. When the customers went bust, Lucent nearly followed. The p...](https://substack.com/redirect/04bd6848-031d-4dad-bcd3-f4fad6be6316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/04bd6848-031d-4dad-bcd3-f4fad6be6316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
The American economy is being disproportionately carried by one thing: **the AI buildout**. Five companies (known by those in the business as the "hyperscalers") plan to spend a combined [$700 to $725 billion on AI infrastructure this year alone](https://substack.com/redirect/cdfd2231-576e-4761-a47d-e43393157191?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). That's more than the annual GDP of most countries, deployed in a single year, by Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta, and Nvidia. Global AI spending will likely exceed [$500 billion in 2026](https://substack.com/redirect/269e5e8d-2b07-4bd0-811e-88c2b13dbf99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to UBS.
That money is showing up directly in the GDP numbers. In Q1 2026, AI-related capital invesments contributed [as much to GDP growth as all of household consumption combined](https://substack.com/redirect/cdfd2231-576e-4761-a47d-e43393157191?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Think about that...consumption is two-thirds of GDP, and data center and AI construction _matched it_ as a growth driver.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/283a9fc7-abb5-44ff-aa29-4c6c44c960ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In 2025, [Harvard economist Jason Furman](https://substack.com/redirect/68a1765a-3d52-41f2-8d30-0e3d8702aae9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) analyzed how the economy might look without the AI spending. His findings are chilling. According to the analysis, AI-related investment in software and equipment accounted for **92% of GDP growth** during the first half of 2025. Without it, annualized growth was **0.1%**. Practically zero. But let's remember, that was last year. Since then, AI investment has gone vertical.
Two weeks ago, Columbia Business School economist [Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh](https://substack.com/redirect/e1e35d2a-2d16-4f87-a1ef-eec0efe0ba75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) said it plainly: "**We 'd basically be in a recession right now without data centers.**" [BCA Research's Peter Berezin](https://substack.com/redirect/12e7bba1-f5cf-47bf-be95-ed112e509fdd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) told the _Wall Street Journal_ the same thing: "It's certainly plausible that the economy would already be in a recession" without the AI boom.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..hfMfflZOZ_Ep2qZPsBOhisPoWybYVdt2PFaAgZFwBsk?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=212327839)
So how does the non-AI portion of the economy look? Sadly, not very healthy. The sectors that employ most Americans are slowing or shrinking. The economy that most people experience is not the economy the headline GDP numbers describe. Sure, if you're an AI tech executive, you're probably loving life. But if you're like most Americans, life is a challenge. I see this every day in the demand for frozen pizza (which seems to be rising steadily), especially when compared to what's happening at restaurants.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/7ddddc55-3458-4b94-8b24-3e44efcc7b92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As regular readers know, my primary thesis in forming Goodwell Foods eighteen months ago was that economic weakness would lead people to eat at home more regularly, with frozen pizza as a big beneficiary. As such, I closely monitor developments in the restaurant industry. It shouldn't surprise anyone that I immediately read the "[Consumer Outlook" report that was published by the National Restaurant Association last week](https://substack.com/redirect/ab1b2ee5-ee88-496b-9a7b-a2eac39af11e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And what I read was not encouraging regarding consumer health. I've pasted three charts from the report that think tell the story of the non-AI economy.
First, US employment trends point to a labor market that is struggling to create meaningful job growth. Remember, this is aggregate data for "Total US Employment" and contains the job growth from the AI buildout. If we excluded construction, energy, and tech jobs related to the AI infrastructure boom, this chart would likely look worse.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/68b1590a-e51d-4161-b7c9-a4fe90f889c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The next two charts show a US consumer that's feeling stretched. US credit card balances are skyrocketing and are currently well over $1.25 trillion, with delinquency rates also rising rapidly. These are not the signs of healthy consumer likely who is likely to keep spending. They also imply most Americans are living "hand to mouth" and don't have ready access to funds in the cope with medical or other emergencies.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dd9acc2d-f34a-4600-82ce-def203609e5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/100b7308-8a14-4fb7-aa2c-8bf689f47a90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**So what does this all mean?** To me, it points to an economic fragility that's downright scary. At the very highest level, I believe we have a struggling American consumer and five companies spending three-quarters of a trillion dollars a year on a technology bet that hasn't fully proven its commercial case.
These extremes are getting buried in aggregate statistics. I often make this dynamic clear during speeches I give by suggesting audience members put their left foot in a bucket of boiling water and their right foot in a bucket of ice water. On average, I note, you'd be comfortable.

| | | | | | Peter,
I want you to understand something about Josh Shapiro and data centers.
Last summer, he was the biggest data center cheerleader in the nation. He told the world he was “comforted” that the future of AI would run through Pennsylvania. He rolled out the red carpet for out-of-state developers and told them our Commonwealth was open for business.
**And then he cashed the checks.**
More than $5 million in campaign donations from out-of-state data center interests poured into Josh Shapiro’s war chest. These are the same developers who are driving up your electric bills, consuming massive amounts of energy, and building on farmland and in neighborhoods without meaningful community input.
Shapiro took their money. And in return, he gave them everything they wanted — fast-tracked permits, sweetheart tax exemptions, and a Governor who looked the other way while communities were left to deal with the consequences.
---
[|

You can’t take millions from an industry and then pretend you’re going to hold them accountable. Pennsylvania voters aren’t buying it, and neither am I.
We need to pause development and make sure residents have the final say.
No exceptions.
And no voluntary “standards” that let out of state data center developers off the hook.

body:
Nathan Johnson will end the Paxton era of corruption.
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=241027%2E444211%2EvcxC4X)
**I want to tell you about my friend Nathan Johnson, the Democrat running for Texas Attorney General – and why this race is one of the most important on the ballot in November.**
The Texas AG runs one of the most powerful legal offices in the country. A good AG serves as an independent check on corruption and the abuse of power. When corporations prey on consumers, when public officials break the law, when anyone tries to use public power for private ends, a good AG can stop them.
**For the last 12 years, Ken Paxton did the opposite. He turned the AG’s office into a partisan weapon** , using it to protect his allies and punish his enemies. And for his corruption and abuse of office, **he was impeached by members of his own party.**
Then came the trial. **Mayes Middleton voted to acquit Ken Paxton and keep him in office.** That’s right: Middleton condoned corruption in the office he now seeks.
**Nathan Johnson is the answer to that.**
I’ve watched Nathan fight in the Texas Senate for years. He flipped a 30-year Republican seat. He expanded health coverage to 350,000 Texans. He strengthened the power grid. And when it came time to hold Ken Paxton accountable, Nathan cast 14 votes to convict him — because he believes, as I do, that no one should be above the law.
Nathan is running to be your lawyer. Not the lawyer for special interests, not for the far-right machine. Your lawyer. He's running to protect consumers, combat corruption, and serve as an independent check on the abuse of power by anyone, anywhere.
Mayes Middleton has already spent more than $20 million of his inherited fortune on this race. **A new poll has this race at one point. One point. Nathan can win this — but he needs our help to get his message to every corner of Texas.**

name: Wes Moore
subject: Conversations.
body:
What I saw in the room:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1804%2E1086043%2Esk-Qc1)
A few weeks ago, I sat down for Jubilee’s _Surrounded_ and debated with 20 people who had not voted in the last election.
**The cynics out there in the world tell us a conversation like the one I had isn’t worth having.** That we’ve become too divided. That everyone has already chosen a side, and the only thing left to do is shout louder than our political opponents.
But that isn’t what I saw in that room. And I do not think it is true in this country. We haven’t crossed a threshold where we can no longer listen to one another or to work together.
The summer that we celebrated America’s 250th anniversary, I’m struck by the fact that our nation’s story has never been one of perfection. It’s one of progress. Generation after generation, Americans have chosen to do their part in expanding the promise of this country.
That work has never been automatic. It has always required participation from people who believe that tomorrow can be better than today.
**[If you share that belief with me, I would appreciate a donation to our re-election campaign today so we can continue our work.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260822-2.CU293i&refcode=em-20260822-2&t=2&akid=1804%2E1086043%2Esk-Qc1)**
I did not go into _Surrounded_ – or write this – to shame people who have opted out of the system.
Quite the contrary. I understand that choice.
I don’t come from a political background. When I ran for office the first time a few years ago, I had to convince many of my family members to vote for me. It’s not like we aren’t cool. They just don’t rush to the ballot box every year.
It struck me that people I love – people who cared deeply about their communities and their country – had been absent from a democratic act that generations of Americans fought for.
Somewhere along the way, they stopped believing that politics had much to do with them – or that anyone in politics had much interest in them. That realization has stayed with me. And it is exactly why I did _Surrounded._
Democracy is a relationship. Those who have the privilege of serving in government share a responsibility to give people a reason to believe their participation counts. To earn their trust. To show the public that government is not something that happens to us, but something we have the power to shape. As an elected official, I take that responsibility seriously. It’s sacred, and essential.
If those of us in public office do our jobs right, then voting becomes about more than casting a ballot. It is an act of hope.
If we’re serious about strengthening democracy over the next 250 years, we cannot only invest in elections. _We have to invest in one another._ The work of patriotism is not passive, and it is not performative. It is service.
Real patriotism asks us to see our humanity in each other before we see our differences. It asks us to remember that the future of this country has always depended on ordinary people doing extraordinary things together – not because they agreed on everything, but because they believed this nation was worth building together, despite our disagreements.
**[If you’re with me, and you believe in what we’re building together, can you chip in any amount to our campaign today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260822-2.CU293i&refcode=em-20260822-2&t=3&akid=1804%2E1086043%2Esk-Qc1)**
My final challenge is a simple one: Sit down with people in your life and in your community who disagree with you. Have honest conversations. Listen. You may be surprised by what you find. And you may even end up working together to make a big difference in our world.
Elevate,
Wes

name: Deb Haaland
subject: Greg Abbott’s agenda has no place anywhere
body:
Peter, Deb Haaland here.
_**My GOP opponent wants to bring Greg Abbott’s agenda to New Mexico.**_
**[We can’t let that happen. Will you split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Gina Hinojosa’s to help us stop Greg Abbott’s agenda from taking hold in New Mexico and Texas this November?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260822_3_haaland.LA3eqE&refcode=em20260822-1895&amount=5&t=1&akid=1895%2E299639%2EORRn5p)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260822_3_haaland.LA3eqE&amount=5&refcode=em20260822-1895&t=20&akid=1895%2E299639%2EORRn5p)
My Republican opponent has said he would work with Texas Governor Greg Abbott to take away reproductive healthcare options from people who need them.
_This will cost people their lives._
Like so many New Mexicans, I relied on Planned Parenthood, Medicaid, SNAP, and WIC to fill the gaps when I was raising my child as a single mother living paycheck to paycheck.
I know how important it is to have access to reliable healthcare and healthy food you can put on the table, and how much these programs can mean to a family when they need a little help making ends meet.
**My opponent wants to bring Greg Abbott’s extremist agenda to New Mexico. I’m running to stop it. And in Texas, my friend Gina Hinojosa is running to stop Abbott’s agenda from continuing.**
Gina and I are both fighting for strong public schools, affordable healthcare, lower costs, and a state government that works for working people. And now, we’re both fighting to stop Greg Abbott’s extremist agenda from taking hold in our states.
[**Will you split a contribution of $5 between Gina’s campaign and mine today to help us win this fight in Texas and New Mexico?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260822_3_haaland.LA3eqE&refcode=em20260822-1895&amount=5&t=21&akid=1895%2E299639%2EORRn5p)
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260822_3_haaland.LA3eqE&amount=5&refcode=em20260822-1895&t=40&akid=1895%2E299639%2EORRn5p)

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

In July of 2019, days after Jeffrey Epstein was arrested, a woman sat down with the FBI and told them she had a photograph.
There were two men in it. She asked the agents to crop one of them out.
Focus on Epstein, she told them. Do not worry about the other guy.
_**The other guy, it later became clear, was Donald Trump.**_
**She is Jane Doe 4**. She has now given the FBI four full interviews about what she says happened to her in 1983, in South Carolina, when Epstein was about thirty years old and nowhere near rich yet. Thirty-seven pages of notes from those interviews are missing from the Epstein files. Last Wednesday, a federal judge in Washington told the Justice Department he is finished waiting for them.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4907bf05-f8c1-4a44-811b-9dfabdb2b194?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Ellie Leonard got onto that call--the line crashed under the volume, and most people never got in. Then she went to Washington and spent the weekend with Katie Phang, whose lawsuit against Todd Blanche is the reason the hearing happened at all. On this week's Epstein Update, she walked us through every piece of it: what Judge Sullivan actually said from the bench, why he pointedly did not hold anyone in contempt, and the story he told about the one time in his career that he did.
Kait Justice opened the show with something that sounds unrelated and is not. Trump's World Liberty Financial was approved for a bank charter three days before we recorded. Reuters then reported that an AI marketplace is going to accept its stablecoin as payment. Every time that coin gets used, the president's family earns. And this administration is pushing AI into everything while stripping the states of the power to regulate it.
Her point, and it is the reason she keeps coming back to this: the architecture is not new. She has been finding the blueprints for it inside the Epstein files.

body:
My plans for the housing crisis

| |
---
| | _With just seventeen days until the primary, I am using each day to discuss an issue I have highlighted on the campaign trail. For Day 17, I am highlighting my plans to address the housing crisis, so that everyone has a place to call home._
* * *
Dear David, Since I launched this campaign, I’ve heard the same thing from families with young kids, college students, and older people: **“We love this state, but we’re not sure we can afford to stay.”** Even if this isn’t _your_ story, chances are you know someone who’s been affected by the skyrocketing cost of housing. **[The housing crisis hurts us all, and it’s time to take real action to solve it. If you’re ready to help me build a movement strong enough to enact real changes so that everyone can have a fair shot at a safe, affordable place to call home, I’d be honored to have your support today →](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/b9YxhUCm7UCVbb_cvTWkeg~~/AAUS1hA~/md7qWaw_tnXybjh6Yzd5UXsFnNj4QKya6YCksJOzoWzWDTKE4o-RQu8XpSvkilFU9U4MwULDxDL-yZMfSWj_TKoJ40wiG5DfEJqiJc_cy9jfvx_7iMgJ6EX9RIeFFYyHwJ0DtGUEqhXE20DqxrFZg7zScyAPwX3kr7ZMR0NBl00AktgYwu-9StjQf-cx-ZhBu7TtkBnxjDAkl-wRbsGsZQpgdoTR11m4HL3wuwwMvTjqhY0ye5kUOzEy2t3jlXWFEyKHUo1H-A-A2X3azRNviQ~~)** | | [DONATE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/b9YxhUCm7UCVbb_cvTWkeg~~/AAUS1hA~/md7qWaw_tnXybjh6Yzd5UXsFnNj4QKya6YCksJOzoWzWDTKE4o-RQu8XpSvkilFU9U4MwULDxDL-yZMfSWj_TKoJ40wiG5DfEJqiJc_cy9jfvx_7iMgJ6EX9RIeFFYyHwJ0DtGUEqhXE20DqxrFZg7zScyAPwX3kr7ZMR0NBl00AktgYwu-9StjQf-cx-ZhBu7TtkBnxjDAkl-wRbsGsZQpgdoTR11m4HL3wuwwMvTjqhY0ye5kUOzEy2t3jlXWFEyKHUo1H-A-A2X3azRNviQ~~)
---
Here’s the situation, David:
The median sale price for a home in New Hampshire has reached $555,000. 76% of renters in New Hampshire cannot afford the median-priced apartment. The annual household income needed to afford the average NH home is now over $150,000, but a typical household only earns $91,000.
Granite Staters are being priced out of the state because of ever-higher rents, utility costs, and property taxes, which then affects businesses and municipalities that are unable to hire because workers can’t afford to live in the communities where they work.
The bottom line is that we can’t afford more of the same. **Solving the housing crisis means standing up to corporate greed and outdated rules, and standing up for the people who make our communities strong.**
So here’s what I’ll do in Congress:
* **Empower New Hampshire's Local Builders** by supporting new federal loan programs and accessible financing so small builders can compete again.
* **Invest in our Communities** by pushing for funding that enables cities and towns to build and maintain critical infrastructure like water and sewer systems and roads.
* **Crack down on Corporate Speculation and Land Hoarding** by working to end tax breaks for hedge funds and private equity firms snapping up single-family homes and supporting caps on institutional ownership to protect opportunities for ordinary buyers and renters.
* **Create Pathways to Affordable Housing** by pushing for support for communities that modernize zoning so we can build the many different kinds of housing we need.
* **Encourage Housing First HUD Policy** by working with federal, state, and local partners to prioritize permanent housing solutions for homeless community members.
* **Support Renters** by working to expand Housing Choice Vouchers and protections for tenants.
* **Fight corporate greed** in the mobile home marketplace _(more on this in a couple days)_.

**[This is what housing policy looks like when we put people ahead of special interests. body:
Derek, we wanted to make sure you saw this from Nate Silver:
---
Derek, we wanted to make sure you saw **this from Nate Silver:** _“With the Democratic lead on the generic ballot ... you’d expect them to overcome the Republican advantage from redistricting. That could grow”

“Polls, historic trends and leading indicators are all fairly consistent in pointing toward Democratic gains.”_ **But here’s the thing, Derek: The polls in August don’t really matter. The only poll that matters happens in November, on Election Day.** It’s true that Democrats have momentum on our side right now. It’s true that electing Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide this year is _imperative_ to putting a massive check on Donald Trump’s agenda in Washington and delivering real change for Americans in their communities. **But it’s also true that none of that is going to happen if we don’t keep working.** The DNC has been hard at work _all year_ registering new voters, knocking on doors, making calls, and investing in the races that need it most. [**And none of that work would’ve been possible without your support. 99.7% of the donations we receive are from grassroots Democrats across the country standing up and chipping in $7 here or $14 there. Peter - It's common sense.

Biological men should NOT be competing in girls' sports.

As a volleyball mom, I've watched our daughters earn every single point on that court. They don't get a pass, and they shouldn't have to compete against biological men who get one.

Washington needs to protect fairness in girls' sports, not let the WNBA push a woke agenda that erases it.

And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish.
| | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, **[please let me tell you why it’s so critical.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6290249b92a94d088847114a57ebdd3a&_e=RjywxI3VZBYX8D3Q6b_DjXLyV4PPUpaJ3g_iDcVeA2bcWB4mgVsMAMrSdotjmKzTP1C8PjHMQYWWN3P45iE-YUW201c9zx7vldORmyV03Fi4CNtolkWqZcPix4I2r7TVjdduUdFbSJ4pmuK3Koh8LZ9jyHoIs0sM6aRMUxNO9WYqAmtHb73npENd8ZIGJppUDQGiODrF2rknmpvTsdGJ0od-cW0NiSoCuamFmin-JTJwaD1-wN6pkf3QgsspfGuj1LeONXsnjaCFQQV4SPLuz_Ei84fioRlFnWIgtvu-98P30PiYZYw4BkPya9dRUcivVOmqf4LVBV0ayusVkcCMP-dYM3MfY35sbbFidwkJsMcLQ2hZL49E_2zFRBWiwknn9Wr6c7LV-BBvBnmD-FNP-ea7v5hLZl4EVTvP1v_bZn3905lrKjgaquu2vrCBNuOcSOBvvnyGjsEMRBVfFDwOpB2tsUQzOiXmoDpQw3FYcAxR7Gv1HR7PB8C6_Qe1sLZdnLYh1Hf8sfD0TfRwNHeE6dBraZ0AEl78wSqvZ17BEiRL2NPOaSbZrjsAL2auq7Dm7vw3ZDDjlHglLk0vtqdx_OWVavulkp0jACKChVhA5UmYNIxAS9BK7KewexRnESXDGodCQaq7Q8FMfcemouZ8_eybjMzHH-cpmhV6TLlhRTmWkPBvU5KGpkoNcezquQ62)** Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.**But today, all that has changed.** Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call _Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ _Little House_ series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... _A is for Activist._ An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” _Woke Baby._ “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” _Prince and Knight._ The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And _The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish._ A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true.

**[That’s why parents and grandparents across the country are rising up through See You At The Library Day.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6290249b92a94d088847114a57ebdd3a&_e=RjywxI3VZBYX8D3Q6b_DjXLyV4PPUpaJ3g_iDcVeA2bcWB4mgVsMAMrSdotjmKzTP1C8PjHMQYWWN3P45iE-YUW201c9zx7vldORmyV03Fi4CNtolkWqZcPix4I2r7TVjdduUdFbSJ4pmuK3Koh8LZ9jyHoIs0sM6aRMUxNO9WYqAmtHb73npENd8ZIGJppUDQGiODrF2rknmpvTsdGJ0od-cW0NiSoCuamFmin-JTLZV9KwakKAhyW6vxSKWhq5tKFNY4Xj6WStZjKX2r5o4MCH5MUgK6BIOmdrsM6UQLSy9hDu07Gh4E-m-ZYhQmu1YIaavh-hru5CM8t51vITVTHEkyv0-tCGOoADZ2Pcoy3P5pQJKX_G6sw9gBaKZb56w3mAOp-VgrDhLo9y_nEGydwBXKutrwvySvTk9Eo_e8BZkdKprS9XabtrjclMj7OceHaGo0OCQeE0XcXpEaWZbNNpbhUebDg2gR5a3uVRFWP-ovezlaIXziubrkA0q2sCyRCiRRRXn-Sk9QhCxoouczNCbJQcAqaLW6bwI6JMLACaOi1m89LFEW1qoS6rAQlMjqz26n0h_VB8-82SAzS1n_VjRIwCkjhp6l_gTJ4ZElEg3k1SYTLmJr70aqKaWhfAEfwhjjZvBdJ4NYw1zI0TWw2FLt8CLDzqUEJPoHE2hYTHhoJMb6LHIMYIx9tOQ3R9)** For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. **And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content.** Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.**But here’s what’s really alarming.** We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.**But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of _other_ children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!** _**[I hope you see why I need your help today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6290249b92a94d088847114a57ebdd3a&_e=RjywxI3VZBYX8D3Q6b_DjXLyV4PPUpaJ3g_iDcVeA2bcWB4mgVsMAMrSdotjmKzTP1C8PjHMQYWWN3P45iE-YUW201c9zx7vldORmyV03Fi4CNtolkWqZcPix4I2r7TVjdduUdFbSJ4pmuK3Koh8LZ9jyHoIs0sM6aRMUxNO9WYqAmtHb73npENd8ZIGJppUDQGiODrF2rknmpvTsdGJ0od-cW0NiSoCuamFmin-JTKcHM71Lm1KudmQ9wnumi5nEYs-TFMzep-PJaVLAEuw7oRVo4jgMbsBndtUxQSon80NjvFL97Xqij_LYf0R8qG0fgiLU2ZeKfnrKtnrKPdQbw5h9FAu2sZo-06Gzg50atVVMNoholeyBys-tLucJEPTTTBf3-y8Hq0MZktkwzg9c-fXgoSkdbnNJ0iJ3gZ6N91bYfpt7ZT8CNcXBU9zSYsCyJiaR6AG5EUzhJkvDTzxKOLdQd0LFbwEhxjGP0E1K40-TrE8O_m6AA_Dx_lMmUaToZKtCCO9kka9az3s31dxsARsUT7Yc2OJFjmem_2M8HvznB82RBGTi-BZIbwKf3OJQB20AowTQ4sITARRXvFEbnytdl4aHOcsgZJlpKJn6y5SvZASCz9qbzABxQkMBxPSHcn7nI5umKa5CjoE4wakAC2i6bDjXdS33MrKCLK0X4b690rmyvyRQV4WO9sKV-gm) **_My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.**Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with _conservative Story Hours_ filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.**And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.**And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books.** It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. **[And this year, honoring America’s 250th birthday, my ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to reach 250,000 children.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=6290249b92a94d088847114a57ebdd3a&_e=RjywxI3VZBYX8D3Q6b_DjXLyV4PPUpaJ3g_iDcVeA2bcWB4mgVsMAMrSdotjmKzTP1C8PjHMQYWWN3P45iE-YUW201c9zx7vldORmyV03Fi4CNtolkWqZcPix4I2r7TVjdduUdFbSJ4pmuK3Koh8LZ9jyHoIs0sM6aRMUxNO9WYqAmtHb73npENd8ZIGJppUDQGiODrF2rknmpvTsdGJ0od-cW0NiSoCuamFmin-JTLvZFpFgqbNqYao6xmzNOvOuxeQNMTQz0Q58RSLVLoP8wMUdAZpRs1H8IPDRQjvW2Jbhbb3-RWjYGMw2oZO36fDUEaF-qeqmLwnTKdf3VGHtOzhgRVzOM8193jRjbkb5pxFw0AGo74a1xtYy-du_wohLW02EVXigAEq2-bk0ke9Z5iiMy-nHurzsR2TnVvlR2eOr15u_LKhPx150pCHwTPui5aLpyydCpLAG7eVkQD5fYTeo-YA0x2tsaJ9DD3ukt3ZaWDzuHmzxFrR0QILrCw40T7tC5zkwhPbcxVj5lQwidiDCUpbjj3mAU9dDwUx_JiiHKz6vtl2RRtqqKZWdskO9TZqDX8iqIuIKs9rFUPmzvF6wDjHxgStM4SSqyBdtVk1rByiQCg6vS4cALhLFyKF9OUYS9ClQ6-N0EDm_AYVoDjWeW12KGD2pdLdFn7MxhN3CM2ZnRmFYUHEDsUj6VAJ)** The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! tax-deductible gift.**Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event.** The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun clean_body: And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. | | | | Fellow Conservative, If you haven’t heard about “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian.She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web.But today, all that has changed. Instead of filling children with wholesome stories, the president of the American Library Association (ALA) says libraries should be used to address ‘systemic racism’ and elevate ‘BIPOC and GLBTQR+ writers and voices.’ Radical librarians call Adventures of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic’ Little House series.And they bring in men wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for.” Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. And The Hips on the Drag Queens Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.”I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco...but that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour” For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating ‘the environment’ to a type of religion. Or maybe you’ve noticed the “Teen Zone” which is really meant to be a “parent-free” zone.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family -- for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action.So, I wrote a little book called “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.Then I decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with conservative Story Hours filled with the classic books you and I grew up with, plus new wholesome books like mine that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism.And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected my request to host our Story Hour.>> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep me out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), my publisher was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on.I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end I got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States.And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those “Story Hours” where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America”, and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part...From there, parents and grandparents started asking how they could host “Story Hours” of their own.And that’s how the nationwide “See You at the Library” movement was born.Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 201 libraries in 46 states. On the same day, across America hundreds of “Story Hours”filled children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God.Conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots stood together for a very simple mission -- to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. The exact date will soon be announced. And before then, I need you! The response from parents, grandparents, and patriots who want to host “Story Hours” has been overwhelming.That’s a very good thing.But it’s going to be a big undertaking and expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold “Story Hours” for 250,000 children. BRAVE for Good was started by BRAVE Books -- the small Christian publisher of my book “As You Grow” –- because so many patriots were asking how they could help “See You at the Library Day” with a tax-deductible gift.Your sponsorship gift helps send a ‘Story Hour Kit’ to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our “Story Hours” for 250,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. We don’t have the millions behind us like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America,Kirk Cameron | | | - 100 I-45 N 260Conroe, TX 77301

Peter, we have to be honest with you.
When Jon first launched his reelection campaign, we weren’t sure what to expect.
Hundreds of thousands of people chipped in to support him in his last Senate race, and we won an incredible victory alongside Rev. Warnock, but that was a long time ago, and a lot has changed since then.
But WOW, Peter! Throughout this campaign, it has been absolutely _incredible_ to see how many people are chipping in again, and how many are getting involved for the first time.
Many people give because they understand that winning back the Senate is our last chance to stop a complete MAGA takeover. Others, because they see the good work Jon is doing in the Senate fighting for Georgians, and want to see that work continue.
No matter your reason for getting involved, _thank you_. But we have to ask you for more today.
We can win this race in a landslide and send an _unmissable_ message to Trump and MAGA, but the ONLY way it’s possible, the ONLY way Jon’s going to have the resources to fight back against the Super PACs and dark money groups... is with our support, Peter.
[**So we’re humbly asking: Can you PLEASE make a donation today — of any amount that feels right to you?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-aug26.Gm-cyv&refcode=em260822-2-subs&utm_campaign=em260822-2-subs&t=2&akid=2736%2E5691347%2E_PbxV8)

When we win this race in November, please know that your support in moments like this is what made it possible.
Thank you for everything.
\- Team Ossoff

A kid from 53206 who built a career on bringing people together | | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquchf2e3e-bIm5hAkq2zKIjvamPfag9y_bswSQjaYCFy9MjdWE1wV2uXo3NcOqsJcFtgsV_KgISdRGF7nV1t9x3SgsO-aaqUD9ktoYt34RgVmDxY81kCR4ywQJhhUlEIjqedEjObkKD3-36Kpb7lcCozMiK9iYOedLQ7WIDc21EuS6ufhIunKMZgX0i6aKhH9m6Rgq6P81oJEuNleZBBcwLfM3LpYfd4YGziXcKslrvxcTiU3nvoxVPJjgJZ-iJ739JufaAfp_-l7m7Rr7ubCE2szKAdLzRnCLmFbqw-5SF2T3dDe6LGt3yqUxayzPlR9Y__TV1YUfacapsvK9i278IurR-7WmjTiJCBYPBuRB9lYJT14gUN-WKLop4sNY3uXsD68tmTBlZ_EasVFoUYA3kJFJHWi30Jz4Gc_ox99LFoc5cJGCqhwjqUGXcz9A4sHs/4te/ngfwUDpbTiWk8raKjrF7Fg/h0/h001.hYXVzix_ncYof91jkerEUqPTp01jt_jrw-XNYoRmmeU) Derek, now that I'm Wisconsin's Democratic nominee for Governor, I wanted to take a minute to introduce myself properly. I grew up in Milwaukee's 53206 ZIP code, where my family faced food insecurity and the threat of eviction. **I know what it feels like when the system isn't built for people like me.** That's what got me into public service in the first place. I got my start in the Wisconsin Legislature, finding common ground with people I didn't always agree with to pass laws that actually helped people. Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 units of affordable housing and push for universal childcare for working families. **I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make lives better for all Wisconsinites.** Wisconsin is one of the closest states in the country. Every one of our last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point. And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism. **That's the kind of race we're in, and we need a large coalition to defend this open seat.** **[_I'm ready for this fight, but I can't do it without support from people like you. I grew up in Milwaukee's 53206 ZIP code, where my family faced food insecurity and the threat of eviction. I know what it feels like when the system isn't built for people like me. That's what got me into public service in the first place. I got my start in the Wisconsin Legislature, finding common ground with people I didn't always agree with to pass laws that actually helped people. Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor, business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 units of affordable housing and push for universal childcare for working families. I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make lives better for all Wisconsinites. Wisconsin is one of the closest states in the country. Every one of our last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point. And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism. A guy on X posted this week that the "experts are in shock," that Micron is putting $50 billion into Boise, that it'll produce 17,000 jobs, and that this is huge for Americans.
We've spent decades being trained to cheer at numbers. A random figure gets announced, a governor stands next to a hard hat with a golden shovel, and we're all supposed to feel something.
I have a different take:
[| | | | | Western Civ Maximalist
---
@brian_lenney
A trillion-dollar company, up +207% this year, +56% profit margins, sitting on a permanent Idaho tax break written for somebody else in 2008. Plus $6.2B federal. Plus zero sales tax on the build. And they filed 573 H-1B applications last year. Idaho kids get the traffic and the
| | | | | Eric Daugherty @EricLDaugh
---|---|---
🚨 JUST IN: The "experts" are in a state of SHOCK after Micron Technology has moved forward with a $50 BILLION memory factory investment in Boise, Idaho -- slated to generate a whopping 17,000 JOBS This is huge for Americans! 🇺🇸 The fake news hates talking about every single
| 2:07 PM * Aug 22, 2026 * 302K Views75 Replies * 198 Reposts * 1.98K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/8d54233f-1074-424d-a8ef-b00fdf1d907b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In 2008 the legislature passed [House Bill 562](https://substack.com/redirect/58bbc537-95e0-4990-a907-7d1a881a9c10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to lure Areva, a French nuclear company, into building an enrichment plant near Idaho Falls. It said if you put $1 billion into the state within seven years, your taxable property value gets capped at $400 million forever.
The French never showed (shocking). But Micron hit the threshold in 2011 and took the deal written for somebody else.
By 2019 Micron's Boise plant was assessed at $1.86 billion. Without the cap, that footprint would have owed $20.32 million in property tax the following year. Its actual bill in 2024 was $3.4 million. The new build sits under a separate entity, so it gets a second $400 million cap. Then [House Bill 678](https://substack.com/redirect/e163e910-bdd5-4d62-afcd-8850c091033f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2022 killed the sales tax on construction materials, and Washington added $6.165 billion in CHIPS money too.
Micron passed a $1 trillion market cap this spring and has been above it since, on $90 billion of revenue at a 56% net margin. This week it announced a $10 billion AI research lab in Boise, funded out of pocket.
That's the company we decided needed "relief."
But wait, there's more! In 2020 the legislature passed [House Bill 521](https://substack.com/redirect/bd3f2973-6b3d-4c56-9666-47970a9f4f5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), exempting data centers from sales tax. The bar: $250 million invested within five years, and 30 permanent jobs.
That's not a typo: _30._
Meta turned up almost immediately with an $800 million campus on farm ground outside Kuna, a town of 25,000. It has since crossed the $400 million threshold too (permanent headcount is around 100) and its record with kids is no mystery with headlines like:
* **[Instagram's chatbot helped teen accounts plan suicide -- and parents can't disable it](https://substack.com/redirect/cf25d7d3-c75d-4ba8-bcc0-06adc1991d32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cf25d7d3-c75d-4ba8-bcc0-06adc1991d32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)(Washington Post)
* **[Hawley opens probe into Meta after reports of AI romantic exchanges with minors](https://substack.com/redirect/21161684-ca62-4819-bbda-33e50147c59e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **(Fox News)
* **[Meta's AI rules have let bots hold 'sensual' chats with kids, offer false medical info](https://substack.com/redirect/eef7a785-9598-42b0-90fc-95126f9ff6f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (Reuters)

What does it cost you?
A Boise homeowner pays about $300 a year more than he otherwise would, a Kuna homeowner about $160. Those are Ada County numbers and I represent Nampa, so here's how it reaches us: _the sales tax exemptions are statewide._ Every dollar we forgive in Boise or Kuna is a dollar the general fund doesn't have, and that fund pays for stuff in Nampa and Caldwell and Melba.
Call it what it is: this is a retired couple in Kuna sending money to Menlo Park, or a framer in Nampa sending money to shareholders in New York and Riyadh.
Chris Bruce and Lori Den Hartog tried to trim it back this session with [House Bill 897](https://substack.com/redirect/62aed7cf-56db-4ef7-8fcc-74ecaf204498?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I voted yes. Micron objected to the part touching its property tax cap, and it died in the House.
### Why these bills always die
Here's a big part of it: dinners, receptions, drunken trips somewhere a lot nicer than Boise in January on somebody else's plane. I get the invitations. Once in a while I'll go to something if there's an actual reason (but we're talking single digits out of a hundred). Saying no to the other ninety-some is a large part of why I have time to sit here and write this.
A lobbyist isn't a stranger to anybody in that building. He's there every day of the session. He learns a member's kids' names, asks after the wife, buys dinner, drinks, and god only knows what else. There's wine and shots and drunk legislators, and by March many legislators have eaten 40 meals with their lobbyist "friends" and maybe two with their own families.
Then a bill comes up and he says what he needs, and it doesn't land on that member as a bribe.
_**It lands as a favor for a "friend."**_
The filing burden falls on the lobbyist, not the legislator, and most of what he files is a lump sum by category. Entertainment. Travel. Lodging. A dollar number with nobody's name attached to it.
Then at the end there's a banquet where a lobbying group hands out awards for being a "friend of Idaho business." None of this is the exception. It's how that building works, and a big chunk of the legislature takes part in it. Nobody breaks a law but somehow men who consider themselves honest cast votes they couldn't explain at home, because the man who asked was a "friend" who bought them drinks.
### Nobody asked about the jobs
But I digress...
Go read House Bill 562 and find me the part that requires anybody to hire anybody.
It isn't in there. [Section 63-4502](https://substack.com/redirect/c0bf7521-14ed-4202-b46a-29ba7738147e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) defines a qualifying investment as a billion dollars of construction and equipment. That's the whole test. No employment floor, no wage standard, no residency requirement, not one word about a human being.
Buy the machines, skip the taxes, forever.
Meanwhile Micron filed 573 labor condition applications last year. H-1B doesn't spread evenly across a new build. It concentrates in exactly the roles a kid from Nampa with an engineering degree is aiming at. Process. Yield. Integration. Design. The construction and technician jobs mostly go local while the career goes to a guy from India.
And that Indian can't quit. His status belongs to his employer, so he doesn't push on wages, doesn't jump to a competitor, and doesn't file the complaint. That's not a knock on him. It's a knock on a company that would rather have a workforce it owns than one it has to bargain with, the same instinct that shipped our plants to China and called it efficiency.
So about those 17,000 jobs. Maybe Micron delivers every one of them. But nothing in Idaho law says they have to, nothing says the jobs go to Idahoans, and nothing happens if the number comes in at 6,000.
We held $50 billion worth of negotiating position and asked for nothing.
### What to do
I'm bringing a bill to repeal all of it. Not sunset it. Not index it. Repeal.
Title 63, Chapter 45, the $400 million cap. Written for a company that never came, passed 41 to 27, no member's name on the bill, and they declared an emergency to backdate it. Brad Little even voted no on it when he was a legislator.
Idaho Code 63-3622VV. The data centers. Thirty jobs.
Idaho Code 63-3622WW. Read subsection 4(e): to qualify you have to already be collecting CHIPS money and already be claiming the 2008 cap. _We wrote the old giveaway into the new one as a prerequisite._ It's a corporate welfare ladder, and we built every rung ourselves.
Three sections need to go.
Because a tax break for one company is a tax increase on everybody else. And a business that has to be paid to come here is coming for the check, not for Idaho. It'll leave for a bigger one.
America First isn't a line for a mailer...
**It means the American worker comes before the shareholder, the kid from Nampa gets first look at the job in his own state, and a trillion-dollar corporation that wants our power and water and roads pays the same freight as the framer down the road and hires our kids while it 's here.**
I'm tired of watching my own party act like the Chamber of Commerce with a flag pin on and what I actually want is harder to put in the tax code. I want a kid who grows up in Nampa to be able to stay in Nampa, own a house on one income, and bury his parents in the county he was born in.
That used to be ordinary here, and no press release with a big number in it is going to bring it back.
